summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何再堆更多图像数据”，而是更难也更接近基座训练的问题：当一个通用图像生成模型同时需要学会 T2I、图像编辑、知识关联、文本渲染、结构化生成等多种能力时，训练数据应该如何按能力依赖关系来组织，而不是按任务孤立构建。作者认为，传统数据管线把 image-caption、editing pairs、知识图文样本分别优化，忽略了能力之间的前置关系和可迁移性，导致监督重复、覆盖低效、课程顺序不合理。论文的核心问题，就是如何把 heterogeneous supervision 重新组织成一个 capability-centric 的数据基础设施，让不同能力沿着依赖顺序共同生长。
summary.importance: 这篇工作与预训练研究的相关性明显高于一般图像生成数据论文，因为它讨论的不是单一数据集质量，而是数据组织原则、能力分解、课程调度和主动回流修正。这些问题与 LLM 预训练里的 data mixture、curriculum、mid-train / continual training、能力导向采样非常接近。它的贡献更偏系统设计和数据方法学，而不是单个算法模块。量级上，如果全文实验扎实，这类工作对多模态基座训练的启发会比“再做一次 recaptioning”更大：它提出的是一种把数据视为能力图谱而非样本池的训练观。
summary.technical_approach:
技术方案由两部分组成：capability-specific data pipeline 和 capability-aligned curriculum scheduling。

先看数据管线。作者没有把所有样本混成一个大池子统一清洗，而是设计了三个可互操作的数据引擎。

第一是 T2I data engine，目标是建立广覆盖的 text-image grounding。全文提到它会做概念覆盖扩展、长尾重平衡、多粒度 caption 对齐，以及 dense caption 构造。这里的关键不是单纯提高 caption 质量，而是让 T2I 数据承担“概念底座”的角色，为后续结构化生成、文本渲染和编辑提供可迁移的视觉词汇与语义对齐。

第二是 image-editing data engine。作者把编辑监督视为多种操作类型的组合，因此不是只收集 source-target pairs，而是为不同编辑类型设计专门构造流程，同时从自然相关图像中挖掘真实关联，并用专家生成样本补足稀缺编辑类型。更重要的是，编辑指令在词汇和描述结构上与 T2I caption 对齐，这样编辑任务可以复用 T2I 已学到的概念表示，而不必在编辑数据里重复覆盖全部视觉概念。

第三是 knowledge-grounded data engine。它通过知识图谱引导的数据获取，把视觉模式与命名实体、结构化知识关联起来。这个设计针对的是一般图像生成模型常见的知识薄弱问题：模型能画出“像某物”的图，但未必能稳定绑定实体、属性和关系。

再看课程调度。作者提出五阶段 curriculum，沿能力依赖顺序逐步扩展训练混合。起点是大规模 T2I，用来建立基础视觉语义对齐和基本生成先验；随后加入结构复杂、知识相关、文本密集的样本，发展结构构图、知识绑定和文本渲染；在 T2I prior 稳定后，再引入 editing data，学习 reference preservation 和 controlled transformation；之后通过 continual training 与 SFT，把 mixture 转向更小、更平衡、更精细的数据子集，并让图像分辨率随内容复杂度提升。这里有四个共同演化轴：任务组成、视觉概念分布、数据质量、图像分辨率。

全文里另一个值得注意的点是 active refinement loop。课程不是一次性写死，而是通过 capability-aware evaluation 把失败模式映射回对应数据引擎，做 targeted retrieval、expert construction、resampling，再把修正后的数据重新注入后续训练。这使它更像一个闭环数据系统，而不是静态配方。

与常见做法相比，这篇工作的区别不在于某个过滤器或 captioner 更强，而在于它把“数据样本”提升为“能力单元”，把“任务数据集”改写成“可迁移监督源”。
summary.experiments:
题面给出的全文片段主要覆盖引言，缺少完整实验表格和具体数字，因此不能虚构参数量、样本规模或精确提升幅度。能从全文叙述中明确提炼出的实验主线有三条。

第一，作者应当评估 capability-specific engines 的独立贡献与互补性，也就是 T2I、editing、knowledge-grounded 三类监督分别带来什么能力增益，以及联合训练是否优于把任务数据孤立构建后直接混合。若实验设计完整，最值得看的是：文本渲染、知识绑定、复杂结构生成、编辑保持度这几类能力是否出现明显迁移收益。

第二，作者强调 curriculum 的依赖顺序，因此实验里大概率会比较 capability-aligned schedule 与固定混合、随机混合、任务独立训练等基线。这里真正重要的不是最终单点分数，而是训练收敛速度、能力出现顺序，以及后期加入 editing / CT / SFT 后是否更稳定。

第三，active refinement loop 应该会通过 failure-driven data augmentation 或 targeted resampling 展示闭环收益。若论文给出案例，建议重点看哪些失败能通过回流修正，哪些失败则说明能力分解仍不充分。

从研究判断看，这篇工作的实验价值主要在“组织原则是否成立”。如果结果只是常规地证明更多高质量数据更好，那信息量有限；如果它能证明按能力依赖组织数据，比按任务堆数据更高效、更可迁移，那就有更强的方法学意义。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓住两个问题：作者如何定义 capability，以及这些 capability 之间的依赖关系是否有可操作的证据。Introduction 里关于 T2I 先于 editing、简单内容先于复杂结构、概念覆盖可跨任务迁移的论证，是理解整篇文章的入口。

接着看三个 data engine 的具体构造。重点不是数据量，而是每个引擎负责补哪类监督缺口、如何与其他引擎共享视觉词汇和标注规范。若正文有示意图或案例表，优先看这些，因为它们最能说明“specialized yet interoperable”到底怎么落地。

然后看五阶段 curriculum 和 active refinement loop。建议留意四个演化轴——任务组成、概念分布、质量、分辨率——是否真的联动，而不是口头描述。若有训练曲线或阶段切换实验，这部分最值得看。

最后看评测设计。若评测只是常规图像生成指标，阅读收益会下降；若作者构造了 capability-aware evaluation，把失败模式映射回数据引擎，那部分更有方法学价值。作为 skim 级阅读，30 到 40 分钟可以抓住主线；若你做多模态预训练数据系统，建议把数据引擎定义、课程表和失败回流机制一起细读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not asking how to simply collect more image data. It asks a more foundational question: when training a generalist image generator that must acquire text-to-image generation, image editing, knowledge grounding, text rendering, and structured composition, how should data be organized according to capability dependencies rather than task silos? The authors argue that conventional pipelines optimize image-caption data, editing pairs, and knowledge-linked samples largely in isolation, which ignores transfer structure between capabilities and leads to redundant supervision and weak curricula. The core problem is how to build a capability-centric data infrastructure so that heterogeneous supervision supports co-evolving capabilities instead of fragmented tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is more relevant to pretraining research than a typical image-generation data paper because it is about data organization principles, capability decomposition, curriculum scheduling, and feedback-driven refinement. Those questions are close to LLM concerns such as data mixture design, curriculum, continual pretraining, and capability-targeted sampling. The contribution is mainly methodological and infrastructural rather than a single algorithmic trick. If the experimental evidence is strong, the paper matters because it treats data as a capability graph rather than a flat sample pool, which is a useful lens for multimodal foundation-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The framework has two main parts: a capability-specific data pipeline and a capability-aligned curriculum schedule.

On the data side, the authors build three specialized but interoperable engines instead of throwing all samples into one global pool.

The first is a T2I data engine for broad text-image grounding. It expands concept coverage, rebalances long-tail distributions, aligns captions at multiple granularities, and uses dense captions where needed. The important design choice is that T2I data is treated as the conceptual base layer. It is not only for standalone text-to-image quality; it is meant to provide reusable visual vocabulary and semantic alignment for later capabilities such as structured generation, text rendering, and editing.

The second is an image-editing data engine. Rather than collecting generic source-target pairs only, the paper describes specialized pipelines for different edit types, mining realistic associations from naturally related images, and using expert-generated examples for sparse edit categories. A key interoperability choice is that editing instructions are aligned with T2I captions in vocabulary and descriptive structure. This allows editing supervision to reuse concepts already learned from T2I data instead of duplicating full concept coverage inside editing datasets.

The third is a knowledge-grounded data engine. It links visual patterns to named entities and structured knowledge through knowledge-graph-guided acquisition. This targets a common weakness in image generators: they may produce plausible imagery without reliably binding entities, attributes, and relations.

On the curriculum side, the paper proposes a five-stage schedule that follows the dependency order of capability acquisition. Training starts with large-scale T2I data to establish broad visual-semantic alignment and a basic generative prior. It then adds structurally complex, knowledge-grounded, and text-rich examples to develop composition, knowledge grounding, and text rendering. Once the T2I prior is stable, editing data is introduced to learn reference preservation and controlled transformation. Later continual training and supervised fine-tuning shift the mixture toward smaller, more balanced, and more refined subsets, while image resolution increases with content complexity. The schedule evolves jointly along four axes: task composition, visual concept distribution, data quality, and image resolution.

A notable systems idea is the active refinement loop. The schedule is not fixed once and for all. Capability-aware evaluation maps observed failures back to the relevant data engine, which then performs targeted retrieval, expert construction, or resampling. The refined data is fed back into later training mixtures. This makes the proposal a closed-loop data system rather than a static recipe.

Compared with standard data-pipeline work, the novelty is not a better filter or captioner in isolation. The novelty is the shift from task datasets to transferable supervision sources organized around capability dependencies.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided full-text excerpt is mostly from the introduction, so it does not expose the full result tables or exact numbers. It would be unsafe to invent model sizes, corpus sizes, or precise gains. Still, the experimental logic is clear from the paper’s framing.

First, the paper should test the independent and complementary value of the three data engines. The key question is whether T2I, editing, and knowledge-grounded supervision each improve distinct capabilities, and whether joint capability-oriented training is better than simply mixing task-specific datasets built in isolation. The most informative outcomes would be gains in text rendering, knowledge binding, complex composition, and edit faithfulness.

Second, because the paper emphasizes dependency-aware curriculum, an important comparison is likely between the proposed staged schedule and baselines such as fixed mixtures, random mixtures, or task-isolated training. What matters here is not only final quality but also convergence speed, emergence order of capabilities, and stability after introducing editing, continual training, and SFT.

Third, the active refinement loop should be evaluated through failure-driven data augmentation or targeted resampling. If the paper includes case studies, the useful question is which failure modes can be repaired by routing them back to the right data engine, and which ones reveal that the capability decomposition is still incomplete.

The real value of the experiments is whether they validate the organizational principle. If the results only show that more curated data helps, the contribution is limited. If they show that organizing data by capability dependencies is more sample-efficient or more transferable than organizing by task silos, the paper becomes much more interesting.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with how the paper defines capabilities and the dependency structure between them. The argument that T2I grounding should precede editing, and that simpler content should precede complex structure, is the conceptual entry point.

Then read the sections describing the three data engines. Focus less on raw scale and more on what supervision gap each engine fills, and how annotation conventions and visual vocabulary are shared across engines. Any diagrams or concrete examples are likely more informative than high-level prose.

Next, read the five-stage curriculum and the active refinement loop. Pay attention to whether the four evolving axes—task composition, concept distribution, quality, and resolution—are actually operationalized rather than described abstractly. Training curves or stage-transition ablations would be especially useful.

Finally, inspect the evaluation design. If the evaluation is only standard image-generation benchmarking, the methodological value is lower. If the paper includes capability-aware evaluation that maps failures back to data engines, that is the part worth studying carefully. For a skim-level read, 30 to 40 minutes should be enough. If you work on multimodal pretraining data systems, the data-engine definitions, curriculum schedule, and failure-feedback loop deserve a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是 LLM，但它把 data mixture 从“按任务拼盘”改成“按能力依赖调度”，这个 prior 值得迁到多模态和 reasoning pretrain；先看数据引擎设计和 curriculum 章节。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but it reframes data mixture from task buckets to capability dependency scheduling; that prior is worth porting to multimodal and reasoning pretraining. Read the data-engine and curriculum sections first.

paper.title: Scaling Domain Data Repetition in LLM Pretraining
paper.abstract: As large language models scale, their training-token budgets must also increase to maintain an appropriate tokens-per-parameter ratio (\(\mathrm{TPP}\)). However, high-quality domain data is much harder to scale than general web data. As model size and the training-token budget increase, its fraction in the training mixture tends to decrease. Repeating the available high-quality data provides an effective way to counteract this dilution, but excessive repetition may lead to overfitting. We study

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个很实际的预训练数据配比问题：模型规模变大时，训练 token 数通常按 tokens-per-parameter ratio 同步增加，但高质量领域数据很难同比例扩张。如果不重复使用这些领域数据，它们在 mixture 中的占比会被通用数据稀释；如果重复太多，又可能过拟合。论文要回答的是，在固定 TPP 的 LLM 扩展设置下，不同领域数据应该重复多少次。
summary.importance: 这是预训练数据 recipe 中很有操作价值的问题。过去关于重复数据的结论常来自固定训练数据量的设置，因此会观察到“大模型更容易因重复而过拟合，重复次数应下降”。这篇论文指出，真实 LLM scaling 更接近固定 TPP：模型变大时训练 token 预算也变大。在这个设置下，结论反过来，最优重复次数会随模型规模温和增加。这个差异会直接影响代码、数学、百科、医学等高质量数据在大模型预训练中的配比策略，也影响用小模型 proxy sweep 迁移到大模型的可靠性。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把问题建模为 mixture pretraining 中的局部领域重复，而不是单一数据集多 epoch 训练。核心变量包括模型规模 N、总训练 token 数 D、TPP=D/N、领域唯一数据量、领域重复次数，以及通用数据补足部分。实验覆盖 code、math、Wikipedia、medical 四类高质量领域。每个领域中，作者改变唯一领域数据比例和重复次数，同时在每个模型规模下固定总训练 token 预算，用这种方式分离“领域占比提升带来的收益”和“重复样本带来的过拟合”。论文还明确比较了两种 scaling 设置：固定 D 时，大模型看到同一批重复样本更容易提前过拟合；固定 TPP 时，D 随 N 增长，重复领域数据被更大的总训练预算和更多通用数据上下文稀释，因此最优重复次数反而上升。另一个关键观察是，最优重复次数和该领域最终 validation loss 强负相关。loss 低的领域通常更可预测、更容易被模型稳定吸收，因此能承受更多重复；loss 高的领域更早进入过拟合区间。
summary.experiments: 论文的实验结论主要有三点。第一，在固定 TPP 下，最优重复次数随模型规模温和增加；这与固定数据量比较下的结论相反。第二，不同领域之间的最优重复次数差异较大，并且与最终 validation loss 强负相关：validation loss 更低的领域可以从更多重复中受益，validation loss 更高的领域更早出现重复带来的退化。第三，在测试的唯一高质量 token 比例范围内，最优重复次数对唯一数据量不太敏感。这个结果给出一个实用流程：可以在较小 proxy model 上保持相同 TPP，任取一个有代表性的高质量数据比例 sweep 重复次数；如果某个重复次数在小模型上没有过拟合，那么迁移到同 TPP 的更大模型时通常偏保守。提供的正文片段没有列出具体模型参数量、token 规模、表格数值和各领域最优重复次数，因此不应额外推断具体数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Figure 1，它把固定数据量和固定 TPP 两种设置的差异讲得很清楚，也是论文最重要的概念入口。然后看实验设置中 mixture 构造、领域数据重复方式、唯一数据比例控制、validation loss 定义和过拟合判据。结果部分重点看三类图表：最优重复次数随模型规模变化的曲线、不同领域 validation loss 与最优重复次数的关系、唯一领域数据量变化下最优重复次数是否稳定。真正值得深挖的是 proxy model 迁移原则：小模型 sweep 不是为了精确预测大模型最优点，而是为了找到在同 TPP scaling 下相对安全的重复下界。这个结论如果成立，会减少大模型数据配比搜索成本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical data-mixture problem in LLM pretraining. As models scale, the training-token budget usually grows with the tokens-per-parameter ratio, but high-quality domain data does not scale as easily as general web data. Without repetition, its mixture share shrinks. With too much repetition, the model may overfit. The paper asks how many times domain data should be repeated under fixed-TPP scaling.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is directly relevant to pretraining data recipes. Prior studies often compare model sizes while holding the total data budget fixed, which leads to the conclusion that larger models should repeat less because they overfit repeated data sooner. This paper argues that practical LLM scaling is closer to fixed TPP, where the token budget grows with model size. Under that setting, the optimal repetition count mildly increases with model size. This changes how one should allocate scarce high-quality code, math, Wikipedia, or medical data in large-scale pretraining mixtures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper treats repetition as domain-specific reuse inside a pretraining mixture, rather than multi-epoch training on a single dataset. The key variables are model size, total training tokens, TPP, the amount of unique domain data, the repetition count, and the amount of general data used to fill the remaining budget. The experiments cover four high-quality domains: code, math, Wikipedia, and medical data. For each domain, the authors vary the amount of unique data and the repetition count while keeping the total training budget fixed for each model size. This isolates the benefit of increasing the domain share from the overfitting risk caused by repeated examples. A central distinction is between fixed-data scaling and fixed-TPP scaling. With fixed data, larger models see the same repeated examples and overfit earlier. With fixed TPP, the token budget grows with model size, and repeated domain data is embedded in a larger training stream, which makes higher repetition counts viable.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical findings are clear. First, at fixed TPP, the optimal repetition count increases mildly with model size, reversing the trend observed under fixed-data comparisons. Second, the optimal repetition count differs across domains and is strongly negatively correlated with final validation loss. Domains with lower validation loss can tolerate and benefit from more repetition, while higher-loss domains overfit earlier. Third, within the tested range, the optimal repetition count is largely insensitive to the amount of unique high-quality data. This leads to a practical procedure: sweep repetition counts on a smaller proxy model at the same TPP using any representative fraction of unique domain tokens, then use the safe region as a conservative guide for the larger target model. The provided text does not expose exact parameter counts, token budgets, tables, or per-domain optimal repetition values, so those numbers should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully. Start with Figure 1, which explains why fixed-data and fixed-TPP comparisons lead to different conclusions. Then inspect the experimental setup: how the mixture is constructed, how domain repetition is implemented, how unique-domain-token fractions are controlled, and how validation loss is used to detect overfitting. In the results, focus on three relationships: optimal repetition versus model size, optimal repetition versus domain validation loss, and stability of the optimum under changes in unique data amount. The most useful idea to examine is the proxy-transfer rule. The small model sweep is not meant to predict the exact optimum for the large model; it is meant to find a conservative safe repetition range under matched TPP.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻把 domain repetition 纳入 mixture sweep；低 loss 领域可多重复这一点会改变常规去重直觉。
recommendation.en: Add domain repetition to the mixture sweep immediately; the low-loss-domains-can-repeat-more result pushes against the usual dedup-first instinct.

paper.title: Into the ORBIT for Time Series: Training Regimes for Foundation Models
paper.abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have advanced primarily through architectural innovation, while training regimes for large-scale heterogeneous corpora remain under-explored. As a result, pre-training distributions are often poorly controlled with respect to domain imbalance, context requirements, prediction horizons, and missingness. We introduce ORBIT (Omni-Range Bootstrap Incremental Training), a training paradigm that makes this distribution explicit and controllable. ORBIT combines Boo

summary.core_problem: 时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的训练 recipe 落后于架构创新，大规模异质语料上的域平衡、上下文长度、预测 horizon 和缺失值分布缺乏显式控制。
summary.importance: 训练范式创新：提出 ORBIT 训练制度，把预训练数据分布从隐式副产品变成可控变量，并训练 Falcon-2.0 时间序列基础模型。
summary.technical_approach: ORBIT 由两部分组成：Bootstrap Multi-Level Sampling 在数据集、记录、目标变量、上下文窗口和预测 horizon 多个层级做采样控制；Omni-Range Incremental Training 在单一训练阶段内逐步变化上下文长度与预测 horizon。Falcon-2.0 采用单变量 encoder-only Transformer、缺失感知三通道 patch tokenization 和并行 patch 预测，并加入 Rank-Guided Cross-Depth Alignment 训练技术。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体参数量、语料规模、baseline 名称或数值指标，仅说明按 ORBIT 训练 Falcon-2.0 并引入跨深度对齐技术。

summary_en.core_problem: Time-series foundation models have advanced mainly through architecture, while training regimes for heterogeneous corpora leave domain balance, context length, prediction horizon, and missingness uncontrolled.
summary_en.importance: Training-regime contribution: ORBIT makes the pretraining data distribution explicit and controllable, and is used to train the Falcon-2.0 time-series foundation model.
summary_en.technical_approach: ORBIT combines Bootstrap Multi-Level Sampling, which controls exposure across datasets, records, target variables, context windows, and horizons, with Omni-Range Incremental Training, which varies context lengths and prediction horizons within a single training stage. Falcon-2.0 is a univariate encoder-only Transformer with missingness-aware triple-channel patch tokenization, parallel patch prediction, and Rank-Guided Cross-Depth Alignment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract provides no parameter count, corpus size, baseline names, or quantitative metrics; it only states that Falcon-2.0 is trained under ORBIT with cross-depth alignment.
summary_en.issues_limitations: No empirical numbers are available from the abstract, so the strength of the training-regime claim cannot be assessed; it is also a time-series-specific model rather than a language foundation model.

recommendation.zh: 时间序列领域的课程/采样 recipe，多层级 bootstrap 采样思路对文本 data mixture 有类比价值，但无实验数字，只看方法节。
recommendation.en: A time-series training recipe; the multi-level bootstrap sampling is a useful analogy for text data mixture, but with no numbers in the abstract, read only the method section.

paper.title: Harnessing the Potential of Optimizing Data Mixtures via Bayesian Domain Reweighting
paper.abstract: The performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) is fundamentally influenced by the distributional composition of multi-domain pre-training data. While manual heuristics were prevalent in early models, they increasingly fail to capture the intricate synergies between domains as data complexity grows. To overcome the issue, a dominant approach seeks to fit a proxy function mapping between domain weights and their corresponding validation losses, and then find the optimal domain weights to minimize

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是预训练数据配比的在线优化问题：如何在不完整遍历大规模语料的情况下，稳定、低成本地学到多域数据的 mixing weights。现有函数拟合类方法依赖 rank invariance、scaling law 等结构假设，小规模试验得到的域重要性在放大到完整训练时会偏移。DoReMi 这类直接优化方法少一些建模假设，但在 one-pass 预训练里权重轨迹振荡明显，收敛慢，成本接近完整预训练。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据研究的启发主要在两个点。第一，它把 data mixture 从确定性权重搜索改成带不确定性的概率推断，适合处理训练早期信号噪声大、域间收益随 token budget 改变的问题。第二，它关注的是可执行的成本约束，而不是只追求最终权重最优。对于真实预训练，mixture search 的试验预算通常很小，能否用 1% 左右训练成本给出可靠方向，比在小模型小数据上拟合漂亮曲线更有用。贡献量级属于数据配比方法上的有意义改进，但还不是完整替代大规模 mixture ablation 的方案。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法 ByDoRe 将域权重 w 建模为 Dirichlet 分布，而不是直接维护一个确定性 simplex 向量。这样做的动机是：在线训练中每个域的损失和梯度信号都有很强噪声，确定性更新容易把短期波动当作长期域价值，导致权重来回震荡。Dirichlet 分布提供了对权重不确定性的表达，相当于在更新时引入概率平滑。论文进一步使用 Gamma-Dirichlet 分层贝叶斯模型，用 Gamma 先验约束 Dirichlet 参数。为避免手工设定先验，又引入 prior prediction network，根据训练过程中观测到的数据和域级信号自适应预测 Gamma 先验的超参数。这接近 empirical Bayes 的思路：先验不是固定常数，而是由当前训练状态估计。与 RegMix、AutoScale、MDE 这类先拟合 mixture-to-loss 代理函数的方法相比，ByDoRe 不把小数据阶段的域排序假定为可迁移；与 DoReMi 相比，它没有直接追逐每一步的域损失差异，而是用分布参数吸收短期振荡。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕 The Pile 多域预训练设定展开。论文强调两个成本数字：在通用下游零样本评测上，ByDoRe 用约 0.8% 的训练成本达到 RegMix 在 Pile 上训练得到的平均准确率；在特定目标下游任务上，用约 1.2% 的训练成本比 RegMix 高 5.2 个百分点。Figure 1 用来说明域重要性随数据规模变化会发生不一致偏移，这是函数拟合类方法估计偏差的来源。Figure 2 展示 DoReMi 的权重轨迹振荡，以及 ByDoRe 更平滑的学习过程。Table 3 对比 RegMix、AutoScale、MDE 等方法在尺度迁移时的性能退化。给定摘录没有提供模型参数量、token 总量、各 benchmark 的完整分项数字，因此精读时需要回到实验表确认：proxy 训练成本如何定义，0.8%/1.2% 是否包含 prior predictor 训练，目标任务是否预先选定，以及 mixture learned on small budget 在不同模型规模上是否稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 RegMix、AutoScale、MDE、DoReMi 失败模式的拆解；看 Figure 1 和 Table 3，确认“域重要性不随规模保持排序”这个经验事实是否充分；看 Methods 中 Gamma-Dirichlet 层级模型和 prior prediction network 的输入、输出、更新频率；看 Figure 2，判断稳定性改善是来自贝叶斯建模，还是来自额外平滑和更新节奏。实验部分需要特别检查训练成本口径、域划分数量、目标验证集选择方式，以及是否存在对特定下游任务调 mixture 的风险。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies online optimization of pretraining data mixtures: how to learn stable domain weights for a multi-domain corpus without spending a near-full pretraining run. Proxy-fitting methods often assume rank invariance or scaling-law structure, but domain importance can shift with data scale. Direct methods such as DoReMi avoid some of these assumptions, yet their deterministic weights fluctuate heavily in one-pass LLM training and converge slowly.
summary_en.importance: The useful idea for pretraining is to treat mixture search as noisy inference rather than deterministic weight fitting. This matters because early domain-level losses are high-variance signals, and the value of a domain can change with token budget. The paper is also framed around a realistic constraint: mixture search must be cheap enough to run before the real training job. The contribution is a meaningful improvement in data-mixture optimization, especially for low-budget search, but it should still be validated against larger-scale mixture ablations.
summary_en.technical_approach: ByDoRe models the domain-weight vector as a Dirichlet distribution instead of a fixed point on the simplex. The uncertainty in the Dirichlet parameters acts as a stabilizer when domain losses oscillate during online training. The method further introduces a Gamma-Dirichlet hierarchical Bayesian model: Gamma priors guide the Dirichlet parameters, and a prior prediction network estimates the Gamma hyperparameters from observed training signals. This is close to an empirical-Bayes design. Compared with RegMix, AutoScale, and MDE, ByDoRe does not rely on transferring a small-scale mixture-to-loss fit to the full-scale run. Compared with DoReMi, it does not chase per-step domain loss changes directly; it uses a distributional parameterization to absorb short-term noise.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are centered on The Pile. The reported headline results are cost-oriented: ByDoRe reaches the average general-purpose downstream accuracy of RegMix with about 0.8% of the training cost, and improves targeted zero-shot downstream accuracy over RegMix by 5.2 percentage points with about 1.2% of the training cost. Figure 1 supports the claim that domain importance profiles shift with data scale. Figure 2 compares the unstable DoReMi trajectory with the smoother ByDoRe trajectory. Table 3 is used to show degradation of proxy-based methods under scale transfer. The provided text does not expose the full model sizes, token counts, or per-task numbers, so the key checks are the exact cost accounting, whether prior-predictor training is included, and how target validation tasks are selected.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Read the introduction for the failure modes of RegMix, AutoScale, MDE, and DoReMi. Inspect Figure 1 and Table 3 to judge whether the scale-shift evidence is strong. In the method section, focus on the Gamma-Dirichlet hierarchy, the inputs and outputs of the prior prediction network, and the update schedule. In the experiments, check the definition of the 0.8% and 1.2% training cost, the number of domains, the validation set design, and whether the learned mixture is robust across model scales.

recommendation.zh: 数据配比是预训练核心性能杠杆，贝叶斯思路避开了代理法的强假设，值得在内部小范围ablation验证
recommendation.en: Data mixture is a core pretraining performance lever; this Bayesian approach avoids strong assumptions of proxy-based methods, worth small-scale internal ablation

paper.title: Similar Models Learn Differently: Final-Window Pretraining Shapes Post-Training Beyond SFT
paper.abstract: Developers judge a model checkpoint by how it behaves. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), two checkpoints that perform about the same across relevant benchmarks are treated as interchangeable, equally ready for the next alignment stage, typically preference optimization. We ask whether this judgment misses a pretraining imprint: a difference that no post-SFT benchmark reveals, yet that decides how each checkpoint responds to further training. To find out, we run a controlled experiment on the f

summary.core_problem: 两个在SFT后基准测试（指令跟随、拒答、通用能力）表现几乎一致的模型checkpoint，是否因预训练最后窗口的数据差异，在后续完全相同的对齐训练（DPO/RL）中表现出不同的可塑性——即SFT后的行为评测是否掩盖了预训练路径留下的不可见印记，导致后续对齐效果出现分化。
summary.importance: 研究结果确立了预训练后期与后训练对齐效果之间的路径依赖关系，挑战了将SFT表现匹配的checkpoint视为等价的通用做法。预训练收尾阶段的数据选择会直接影响SFT植入行为在后续对齐中的保留程度，对预训练末期的数据配比、课程设计有直接指导意义。研究提出的拒答侵蚀指标，将SFT初始行为水平与后续训练带来的变化幅度分离开，相比仅比较端点的方法是方法学上的改进。
summary.technical_approach: 从同一个部分预训练的OLMo-2-1B checkpoint分叉出6个分支，唯一变量是预训练最后窗口（5亿token，占此前预训练token量的0.1%~1%）的数据内容，例如安全领域数据、通用网页数据等。所有分支随后经过完全相同的Tulu风格SFT，再分别进行相同的UltraFeedback DPO训练（主实验），其中两个主分支额外进行GRPO强化学习更新。核心评测指标为拒答侵蚀，即SFT后到后训练后的有害请求拒答率下降幅度，该指标将共享后训练阶段的影响与SFT初始性能差异分离开，避免端点比较的混淆。通过控制变量消融测试了最后窗口内容、出现顺序（保护性行为相关数据是否必须放在最后）、窗口大小、学习率、偏好数据、跨模型族泛化性（在Pythia-1B上复现）等维度的影响。
summary.experiments: 核心实验结果包括：1）6个分支在SFT后的指令跟随、拒答能力、通用能力基准上表现高度接近，但经过完全相同的DPO训练后，拒答侵蚀程度出现显著差异。2）最后窗口使用安全数据的分支，后训练中拒答能力的流失远少于网页数据分支，尽管二者SFT后的初始拒答率基本一致。3）该效应要求安全数据出现在预训练的最后阶段，将相同数据移到更早的预训练位置，效应消失。4）效应强度随最后窗口占比缩小而减弱，当窗口大小仅为此前预训练量的几个基点时，效应趋近于零。5）这种分化不局限于特定后训练算法：在DPO和GRPO两种训练方式下均存在，且在Pythia-1B模型族、不同学习率、不同偏好数据集下均能复现。实验所用模型参数量为1B，最后窗口token量为5亿。
summary.reading_guide: 精读重点：首先看引言部分的路径依赖假设与拒答侵蚀指标的提出逻辑，这是核心概念贡献。然后仔细阅读方法部分的匹配checkpoint实验设计，理解研究者如何控制变量以隔离最后窗口的单一影响。结果部分优先关注Figure 1（分化效应预览图）以及几组消融实验：最后窗口内容与顺序的对比、窗口大小的缩放规律、跨模型族复现、GRPO场景下的泛化性。值得进一步深挖的方向：最后窗口塑造可塑性的底层机制是什么，是参数空间的位置差异、特征表示的不同，还是记忆的近因效应？该效应在更大参数量、更长预训练流程下的缩放规律如何？

summary_en.core_problem: Whether two model checkpoints that perform nearly identically on standard post-SFT benchmarks (instruction following, refusal, general capability) still carry divergent imprints from the final pretraining window, such that they respond differently to identical subsequent alignment training (DPO or RL). In other words, whether standard post-SFT evaluation is blind to pretraining path-dependent differences that shape post-training plasticity.
summary_en.importance: The findings establish a clear path dependence between late pretraining and post-training alignment outcomes, challenging the common practice of treating SFT-matched checkpoints as interchangeable. Data selection in the final stage of pretraining directly affects how well SFT-installed behaviors survive later alignment, offering concrete guidance for designing final-stage pretraining data mixtures and curricula. The refusal erosion metric also introduces a way to disentangle initial post-SFT behavior levels from the magnitude of change induced by subsequent training, a methodological improvement over endpoint-only comparison.
summary_en.technical_approach: The experiment forks 6 branches from a single partially pretrained OLMo-2-1B checkpoint, with the only variable being the data used in the final 500M-token pretraining window (0.1% to 1% of preceding pretraining tokens, e.g., safety data, general web data). All branches then undergo identical Tulu-style SFT, followed by either UltraFeedback DPO (primary experiment) or GRPO RL update (for two headline branches). The core metric is refusal erosion: the drop in harmful request refusal rate from the SFT checkpoint to the post-training checkpoint, which isolates the effect of the shared post-training stage from initial SFT performance differences. Controlled ablations test the effect of final window content, ordering (whether protective data must come last), window size, learning rate, preference data, and cross-model-family generalizability (replicated on Pythia-1B).
summary_en.experiments: Key findings: 1) All 6 branches are closely matched on post-SFT benchmarks (instruction following, refusal, capability), but diverge significantly in refusal erosion under identical DPO. 2) Branches with safety data in the final window lose far less refusal under post-training than web-data branches, despite starting from similar SFT refusal levels. 3) The effect requires safety data to appear last in pretraining; moving the same data to an earlier position eliminates the effect. 4) Effect strength weakens as the final window shrinks, approaching near-zero when the window is only a few basis points of prior pretraining. 5) The divergence is not algorithm-specific: it appears under both DPO and GRPO RL, and replicates across the Pythia-1B family, different learning rates, and different preference datasets. Model size: 1B parameters; final window size: 500M tokens.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus first on the Introduction for the path dependence hypothesis and the rationale behind the refusal erosion metric — this is the core conceptual contribution. Then read the Methodology section carefully for the matched-checkpoint experimental design and how variables are controlled to isolate the final window effect. For results, prioritize Figure 1 (preview of divergence) and the ablation sections: final window content vs. ordering, window size scaling, cross-model replication, and GRPO generalization. Worth digging deeper into: the underlying mechanism of how the final window shapes plasticity (whether it is parameter landscape position, feature representation differences, or recency of memory), and how this effect scales with larger model sizes and longer pretraining runs.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对“可互换 checkpoint”的 prior：先看实验设计和 post-training 分化结果，若 setup 真干净，内部应立刻复现 final-window ablation。
recommendation.en: This directly challenges the 'interchangeable post-SFT checkpoints' prior; if the controls are as clean as claimed, final-window ablations should move onto your internal pretrain→post-train checklist.

paper.title: Shieldstral
paper.abstract: We introduce Shieldstral, a 3B-parameter policy-adaptive multimodal safety classifier that matches or outperforms models nearly 7$\times$ its size on text safety benchmarks and sets a new state of the art on multimodal safety classification. Shieldstral formulates content moderation as a binary question-answering task. This simple formulation unifies diverse moderation tasks into a single yes/no problem, enabling heterogeneous safety datasets with divergent taxonomies to be consolidated under on

summary.core_problem: 如何用较小参数量的多模态安全分类器统一处理不同安全 taxonomy，并在策略变化下保持适配能力。
summary.importance: 这是安全后训练/分类器方向的工作，贡献主要在数据构造和任务表述统一，不是基座预训练。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于看 heterogeneous safety data 如何被统一成单一训练接口。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Shieldstral，一个 3B 参数的 policy-adaptive multimodal safety classifier，把内容审核统一表述为二元问答任务。通过该表述把不同来源、不同标签体系的安全数据并入同一训练框架，并构建约 54.1M 样本的数据配方与细粒度评测集。
summary.experiments: 模型规模为 3B，声称在文本安全 benchmark 上匹配或超过接近 7 倍参数的模型，并在多模态安全分类上取得新的最好结果。核心 baseline 是更大规模的安全分类模型，但摘要未给出具体数据集拆分、误报漏报权衡和跨政策泛化细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单中有 Guillaume Lample、Pierre Stock 等，属于 Mistral 相关团队常见作者。论文更像安全分类器与数据工程工作，而非 foundation pretraining。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how a relatively small multimodal safety classifier can unify heterogeneous safety taxonomies and remain adaptable under changing policies.
summary_en.importance: This is a safety post-training/classification paper. Its main value lies in data construction and task unification rather than foundation-model pretraining. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is how heterogeneous safety data are mapped into one training interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: Shieldstral is a 3B policy-adaptive multimodal safety classifier that formulates moderation as binary question answering. This lets the model consolidate diverse safety datasets with incompatible taxonomies into a single training framework, supported by a 54.1M-sample data recipe and a fine-grained evaluation set.
summary_en.experiments: The model has 3B parameters and reportedly matches or outperforms models nearly 7x larger on text safety benchmarks while setting a new best result on multimodal safety classification. The abstract does not provide the detailed dataset split, false-positive/false-negative tradeoff, or cross-policy generalization details.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Guillaume Lample and Pierre Stock, consistent with the Mistral ecosystem. This is better viewed as a safety-classifier and data-engineering paper than a foundation-pretraining one.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不深，但“把异构安全 taxonomy 压成统一二元 QA 接口”这个数据工程思路可借鉴；读数据配方即可，别花太多时间在榜单上。
recommendation.en: Not deeply tied to pretraining, but the trick of collapsing heterogeneous safety taxonomies into one binary-QA interface is reusable; read the data recipe, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: DecoupleMix: Decoupled Ratio Search and Convex Allocation for Scalable VLM Data Recipes
paper.abstract: While data curation for Vision Language Models (VLMs) is increasingly active, public practice for constructing pretraining mixtures remains largely heuristic: practitioners stack datasets that pass quality filters, set cross-domain ratios by intuition, and lack a principled, attributable criterion for admitting new data, while frontier recipes remain undisclosed. We formulate data construction as a systematic mixture-optimization problem and turn it into a reproducible engineering discipline by

summary.core_problem: 当前VLM预训练（尤其是持续预训练）的数据混合配方缺乏系统化、可复现的框架。开源实践依赖启发式质量过滤、数据集暴力堆叠和人工直觉设定跨域比例，存在两个核心缺陷：一是仅关注噪声清洗，缺乏对数据难度、多样性的系统评估；二是跨能力类别的比例（类间）与同类别内多数据源配比（类内）未做解耦，高维联合搜索不可行，新数据集引入的效果无法归因。前沿闭源配方未公开，进一步阻碍了开源数据管线的迭代优化。
summary.importance: 该工作将VLM数据混合构建从经验性手艺转化为可复现的工程流程。类间/类内解耦优化的思路可直接迁移到纯文本LLM、统一多模态预训练的数据混合场景；提出的数据集级评估+可归因数据准入机制，解决了传统方案中新增数据集需全量重训重扫的高成本问题；小代理模型上搜索得到的比例可跨数据、模型规模直接迁移，大幅降低大模型数据配方的搜索成本。这是可直接落地到工业级数据管线的方法论级改进。
summary.technical_approach: 核心思路是将单一的“如何混合数据”问题拆解为两个正交子问题，配套三模块闭环系统：1）自动化数据集级评估：以数据集为最小评估单元（适配工业管线、避免样本级标注噪声），采用LLM-as-Judge范式（使用Seed-1.6模型，每个数据集采样150条样本），从三个维度量化：能力分类（基于自然语言定义的可扩展能力分类体系，无需人工标注，支持新增能力类别）、质量（4个维度，加入幻觉惩罚项）、难度（6个维度，侧重跨模态合成与先验知识要求）。人类对齐验证显示质量分与人类共识Spearman相关系数r=0.82，难度分r=0.75，满足优化稳定性要求。2）解耦混合优化：类间比例（如图文/视频文、接地/字幕等能力类别的token预算分配）采用坐标式单变量迭代搜索，以公开参考配方的平均值为热启动，每轮固定其他类别比例、仅扫描单个类别的比例候选集（其余类别重归一化），选取验证集最优值，避免多变量混淆；类内比例（如多个OCR数据集的混合）采用带约束的凸优化，目标函数显式加入熵项保证多样性，结合质量、难度分加权，避免冗余数据堆叠。3）标准化数据准入：固定类间比例、总token预算、类内优化策略，将新数据集引入转化为单变量可控干预，无需全量重扫配方即可准确测量其效果。评估阶段采用选择题（MCQ）验证代理检查点，降低对自由形式指令跟随能力的依赖。
summary.experiments: 已公开的关键结果包括：1）自动化数据集级评分与人类共识的相关性：质量分Spearman r=0.82，难度分r=0.75，满足下游优化的稳定性要求；2）类间比例采用单变量坐标式搜索，每轮仅调整一个类别比例，避免多变量混淆，相比不可行的高维联合搜索大幅降低计算复杂度，优化过程可解释、易复现；3）在代理模型规模上搜索得到的配比，无需额外调参即可直接迁移到更大的模型与数据规模；4）基于优化后配方，使用80B多模态token完成持续预训练的VLM，性能与同期强开源基线（LLaVA系列、Qwen3-VL等）持平；5）固定类间比例、总预算与类内策略后，新数据集的引入变为单变量可控干预，无需执行传统的“重堆叠全量重训”消融即可准确测量其效果，大幅降低评估成本。
summary.reading_guide: 精读优先级：1）方法章节2.1节（自动化数据集级评估）：重点关注能力分类体系的自然语言定义方式、LLM-as-Judge的prompt设计（附录B）、人类对齐验证的实验设置，这是整个框架的基础模块，可直接复用至其他预训练数据管线；2）方法章节2.2节（解耦混合优化）：重点关注类间单变量搜索的热启动策略、收敛判据，类内凸优化的目标函数设计（尤其是多样性熵项的权重设置）与约束条件定义，这是核心创新点，可直接迁移到纯文本LLM的数据配比优化；3）方法章节2.3节（标准化数据准入）：重点关注单变量干预的控制变量设计，这是解决数据迭代归因问题的关键；4）实验章节的消融部分：重点关注比例跨规模迁移的验证、解耦优化与联合搜索的成本-性能权衡。值得深挖的方向：类间搜索的验证集选择如何避免过拟合、难度分与数据课程学习的结合方式、熵项权重对冗余数据的抑制效果边界。
summary.authors_note: 基于对Seed系列模型的引用，该工作大概率来自字节跳动多模态预训练团队（Seed模型系列的开发方）；具体作者信息未在给定内容中披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Current VLM pretraining (especially continued pretraining) data mixture pipelines lack a principled, reproducible framework. Open-source practices rely on heuristic quality filtering, brute-force dataset stacking, and intuition-driven cross-domain ratio setting, with two critical flaws: first, pipelines focus only on noise removal without systematic assessment of data difficulty and diversity; second, inter-class (across capability categories) and intra-class (within a single category) ratio optimization are not decoupled, making high-dimensional joint search intractable and the impact of new dataset additions un-attributable. Frontier proprietary recipes remain undisclosed, blocking iterative improvement of open data pipelines.
summary_en.importance: This work formalizes VLM data mixture construction from an empirical craft into a reproducible engineering discipline. The decoupled inter/intra-class optimization paradigm directly transfers to pure-text LLM and unified multimodal pretraining data mixing scenarios. The proposed dataset-level assessment + attributable data admission mechanism eliminates the high cost of full re-training and re-sweeping when adding new datasets. Ratios searched on small proxy models transfer across data and model scales without additional tuning, drastically reducing recipe search cost for large-scale models. This is a methodological improvement that can be directly integrated into industrial-grade data pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core insight is to decompose the monolithic data mixture problem into two orthogonal sub-problems, supported by a closed-loop system with three modules: 1) Automated dataset-level assessment: Uses datasets as the minimal evaluation unit (aligns with industrial pipelines, avoids sample-level annotation noise) and adopts the LLM-as-Judge paradigm (Seed-1.6 model, 150 samples per dataset) to quantify three dimensions: capability classification (based on an extensible taxonomy defined via natural language, no manual labeling required, supports new capability categories), quality (4 dimensions, with hallucination penalty), and difficulty (6 dimensions, prioritizing cross-modal synthesis and prior knowledge requirements). Human alignment validation shows Spearman correlation r=0.82 for quality scores and r=0.75 for difficulty scores, meeting stability requirements for downstream optimization. 2) Decoupled mixture optimization: Inter-class ratios (token budget allocation across capability categories e.g., image-text vs video-text, grounding vs captioning) use coordinate-style single-variable iterative search, warm-started from the average of public reference recipes. Each round sweeps one category's ratio candidates while fixing others (with renormalization) and selects the value with best validation performance, avoiding multi-variable confounding. Intra-class ratios (e.g., mixing multiple OCR datasets) use constrained convex optimization, with an explicit entropy term in the objective to enforce diversity, weighted by quality and difficulty scores to avoid redundant stacking. 3) Standardized data admission: Fixes inter-class ratios, total token budget, and intra-class strategy, turning new dataset addition into a single-variable controlled intervention whose impact can be measured directly without full recipe re-sweeping. Multiple-Choice-Question (MCQ) validation is used to evaluate proxy checkpoints to reduce dependence on free-form instruction following.
summary_en.experiments: Key reported results include: 1) Automated dataset-level scores show strong correlation with human consensus: Spearman r=0.82 for quality, r=0.75 for difficulty, meeting stability requirements for downstream optimization. 2) Inter-class ratio optimization uses coordinate-style single-variable search, adjusting only one category's ratio per round to avoid multi-variable confounding, drastically reducing computational complexity compared to intractable high-dimensional joint search, with an interpretable and reproducible process. 3) Ratios searched on proxy-scale models transfer directly to larger model and data scales without additional tuning. 4) A VLM trained with 80B additional multimodal continued-pretraining tokens under the optimized recipe matches the performance of strong contemporary open-source baselines (LLaVA series, Qwen3-VL, etc.). 5) With fixed inter-class ratios, total token budget and intra-class strategy, new dataset addition becomes a single-variable controlled intervention, whose impact can be accurately measured without traditional expensive "restack and full retrain" ablations, greatly reducing evaluation cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Priority reading order: 1) Section 2.1 (Automated Dataset-Level Assessment) in Methodology: Focus on the natural-language-defined capability taxonomy design, LLM-as-Judge prompt templates (Appendix B), and human alignment validation setup — this is the foundational module that can be directly reused for other pretraining data pipelines. 2) Section 2.2 (Decoupled Mixture Optimization): Focus on the warm-start strategy and convergence criterion for inter-class single-variable search, the objective function design for intra-class convex optimization (especially the weight setting of the diversity entropy term), and constraint definitions — this is the core innovation, transferable to pure-text LLM data mixing. 3) Section 2.3 (Standardized Data Admission): Focus on the control variable design for single-variable intervention, the key to solving data iteration attribution. 4) Ablation studies in Experiments: Focus on cross-scale ratio transfer validation, and cost-performance tradeoff between decoupled and joint search. Points for further exploration: how validation set selection for inter-class search avoids overfitting, integration of difficulty scores with data curriculum learning, and the boundary of entropy term weight's suppression effect on redundant data.
summary_en.authors_note: Based on citations of the Seed model series, the work is likely from ByteDance's multimodal pretraining team (developer of the Seed model family); specific author names are not disclosed in the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 应重点看目标函数和消融；若实验规模够干净，inter/intra mix 解耦值得放进内部数据配比搜索。
recommendation.en: Read the objective and ablations first; if the scale is clean, the inter/intra mixture split is worth trying in internal data-recipe search.

paper.title: DomainPilot: Domain-Level Loss-Guided Two-Stage Data Mixture Optimization for Efficient Language Model Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: The training efficacy of large language models (LLMs) is fundamentally constrained by the quality and composition of training data. Existing dynamic data scheduling methods face critical limitations in industrial-scale pretraining and supervised fine-tuning (SFT): data selection incurs prohibitive O(N) costs on terabyte-scale corpora, mixture optimization schemes introduce severe I/O bottlenecks or require training auxiliary reference models, and sample-level reweighting strategies rely on loss

summary.core_problem: 工业级 LLM 预训练和 SFT 中的动态数据混合优化面临成本高昂、I/O 瓶颈或依赖不可靠的样本级损失信号等问题，且现有方法难以无缝集成到 Megatron-LM 等主流训练框架中。
summary.importance: 提出了一种轻量级、框架无关的领域级数据混合优化方案，解决了大规模预训练中数据配比动态调整的工程和算法痛点，对提升数据效率和模型最终性能具有实际工业价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DomainPilot，一个领域级损失引导的两阶段数据混合优化框架。首先，通过非侵入式补丁实现 Token 级的领域损失监控，在不中断训练的情况下捕获各领域的学习动态。其次，两阶段优化：阶段一利用领域特定的 Scaling Laws 提取先验信息（收敛损失、速度等）进行粗调；阶段二在粗调基础上进行 Mixing Law 扫描实验，建模跨领域交互，在局部范围内精调配比。架构上采用算法层与适配器层分离的设计，易于迁移。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-1.7B 上进行验证。优化后的数据混合比例在不增加数据或计算成本的情况下，使模型在 LiveCodeBench v5 上提升 3.8%，BFCL v3 上提升 3.6%，在 MMLU-Redux 和 AIME24 上也有稳定提升。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Methodology 中 Token 级领域损失监控的实现细节，以及两阶段优化（Scaling Law 粗调 + Mixing Law 精调）的逻辑。了解其如何通过少量代码修改适配 Megatron-LM 框架。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Dynamic data mixture optimization in industrial-scale LLM pretraining and SFT faces prohibitive costs, I/O bottlenecks, or relies on unreliable sample-level loss signals. Furthermore, existing methods are difficult to integrate seamlessly into mainstream frameworks like Megatron-LM.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a lightweight, framework-agnostic domain-level data mixture optimization solution, addressing the engineering and algorithmic pain points of dynamic data proportion adjustment in large-scale pretraining, offering practical industrial value for improving data efficiency and final model performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces DomainPilot, a domain-level loss-guided two-stage data mixture optimization framework. First, it implements token-level domain loss monitoring via a non-intrusive patch to capture per-domain learning dynamics without halting training. Second, a two-stage optimization: Stage 1 uses domain-specific Scaling Laws to extract priors (convergence loss, speed, etc.) for coarse reallocation; Stage 2 conducts Mixing Law sweep experiments around the coarse baseline to model cross-domain interactions and refine proportions locally. The architecture separates the algorithm layer from the adapter layer for easy migration.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Qwen3-1.7B. The optimized mixture improved performance by up to 3.8% on LiveCodeBench v5 and 3.6% on BFCL v3, with consistent gains on MMLU-Redux and AIME24, without additional data or compute costs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the implementation details of token-level domain loss monitoring in the Methodology, and the logic behind the two-stage optimization (Scaling Law coarse tuning + Mixing Law fine-tuning). Understand how it adapts to the Megatron-LM framework with minimal code changes. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做 data mixture 的人可以看：它把 sample-level 选择降到 domain-level，方向对，但先别全信收益，优先看收敛曲线拟合是否真能稳定预测后续最优配比。
recommendation.en: Worth a look if you work on data mixture: the domain-level reduction is sensible, but the real question is whether the fitted convergence curves actually predict better mixtures rather than just smoothing noise.

paper.title: Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation
paper.abstract: Multimodal foundation models learned to see and to speak by consuming the whole internet. Embodied agents admit no such shortcut, since they require data that couple observations with physical states and actions. These signals can be provided, to varying degrees, by multiple data sources. In this work, we organize the embodied data ecosystem as a "pyramid" spanning five complementary sources: real-robot data, UMI-style data, egocentric and exocentric data, simulation data, and general vision-lan

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理的是具身基础模型的数据组织问题：机器人预训练不能直接复用互联网文本和图像的规模化路径，因为它还需要状态、动作、接触、动力学和可执行监督。不同数据源在可扩展性、机器人对齐和物理真实性之间有明显取舍，但社区缺少一个稳定的分类框架来比较和组合这些数据。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练研究的直接价值不高，但对“多模态/具身预训练的数据配比”有启发。它把具身数据看成一个数据生态，而不是单一 robot trajectory 数据集问题。这个视角类似文本预训练里的 web、code、math、synthetic、high-quality corpus 配比问题：不同数据源提供不同训练信号，关键不只是数据量，而是信号是否能迁移到目标行为。局限也比较清楚：这是一篇数据中心视角的综述和框架整理，不提供新的 scaling law、训练配方或可复现实验结论。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是提出一个五层 Data Pyramid。自上而下分别是 real-robot data、UMI-style data、egocentric/exocentric human interaction data、simulation data、general vision-language data。排序依据是两个主轴：scalability 和 robot alignment。real-robot 数据最接近部署机器人，动作可直接执行，物理反馈真实，但采集成本高、重置和安全监督昂贵。UMI-style 数据去掉机器人本体，用手持或端执行器中心的采集方式保留操作轨迹，因此比真机数据更容易扩展，也比普通视频更接近可执行动作。ego/exo 视频覆盖人类交互、任务阶段和 affordance，但动作空间和机器人控制之间有映射缺口。simulation 可大规模生成带状态和动作的轨迹，但受资产、任务设计和 sim-to-real 差异限制。general vision-language 数据规模最大，提供语义和视觉先验，但缺少物理交互和动作监督。除两个主轴外，工作还用 quality、diversity、reusability、physical fidelity 四个维度解释为什么“更多数据”不一定带来更好的具身能力。
summary.experiments: 没有新的模型训练实验或严格消融。主要证据来自对已有 embodied foundation models 和代表性数据集的整理分析。文中强调的经验结论包括：真机数据的机器人对齐和物理真实性最高，但规模最受限；UMI-style 数据在可扩展性和可重定向性之间提供折中；人类第一/第三视角视频适合学习任务分解、手物交互和 affordance，但不能直接替代动作监督；仿真数据可控、便于自动生成失败和恢复轨迹，但物理细节、传感噪声和接触建模会影响迁移；通用图文/视频语言数据主要补语义和视觉知识，不能单独支撑操作策略学习。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 scalability 和 robot alignment 的定义，以及 Data Pyramid 的五层划分。图表部分如果包含数据集分布、不同数据源维度比较、近期模型数据配方对照，值得快速扫一遍。对预训练研究员更有用的是它的数据组织语言：如何把数据源按训练信号拆开，而不是只按模态或采集设备命名。无需细读所有具身模型案例，除非正在设计 VLA 或机器人 foundation model 的数据 mixture。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a data organization problem for embodied foundation models. Robot pretraining cannot simply copy the internet-scale recipe used for language and vision, because embodied agents need supervision over states, actions, contacts, dynamics, and executable behavior. Existing data sources provide these signals with different trade-offs, but the field lacks a clear framework for comparing and combining them.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not central to text LLM pretraining, but it is useful for thinking about data mixtures in embodied and multimodal pretraining. Its main contribution is a data-centric taxonomy: different sources are treated as different supervision channels rather than as interchangeable data pools. This is close in spirit to mixture design in LLM pretraining, where web text, code, math, synthetic data, and curated corpora contribute different gradients. The limitation is that the paper is a survey and framework piece; it does not introduce a new training recipe, scaling result, or controlled empirical law.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a five-level Data Pyramid: real-robot data, UMI-style data, egocentric and exocentric human interaction data, simulation data, and general vision-language data. The two primary axes are scalability and robot alignment. Real-robot data is directly aligned with the platform that produced it and has high physical fidelity, but it is expensive to collect and reset. UMI-style data removes the robot from the collection loop while retaining end-effector-centric manipulation signals, making it more scalable than robot demonstrations and more actionable than ordinary video. Human ego/exo video captures task structure, affordances, and hand-object interaction, but lacks robot-native action labels. Simulation provides controllable state-action trajectories, with transfer limited by assets, task coverage, and sim-to-real gaps. General vision-language data supplies broad semantic and perceptual priors but weak physical and action supervision. The paper further characterizes each source by quality, diversity, reusability, and physical fidelity.
summary_en.experiments: There are no new controlled training experiments. The evidence is mainly an organized analysis of representative datasets and recent embodied foundation models. The key observations are qualitative: real-robot data has the strongest execution alignment but the weakest scalability; UMI-style demonstrations offer a practical middle ground for manipulation; human videos are reusable for task decomposition and affordance learning but need action grounding; simulation is scalable and controllable but constrained by physical mismatch; general vision-language data helps perception and semantics but cannot replace interaction data.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the definitions of scalability and robot alignment, the five-layer pyramid, and any tables or figures comparing data sources and model data recipes. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is the data-mixture vocabulary: which supervision signal each source provides, what it fails to provide, and why scale alone is insufficient. The long catalog of embodied models can be read selectively unless you are actively designing a VLA or robot foundation model data pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫数据金字塔和模型配方表；它不能直接迁移到 LLM，但能校准多模态预训练里的“规模 vs 对齐”取舍。
recommendation.en: Skim the data pyramid and recipe tables; it will not transfer directly to LLMs, but it calibrates the scale-versus-alignment tradeoff in multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: A Unified Moral-Value Dataset for Instruction Tuning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have developed rapidly and become valuable tools in everyday life. However, how to align LLMs to a particular set of human values is still an open problem. Recent studies show that instruction tuning has strong potential for zero-shot tasks and may serve as an effective approach to addressing value alignment. Nevertheless, although many datasets for instruction tuning already exist, they are not specifically designed around moral scenarios and behaviors. We construct

summary.core_problem: 把分散的道德/价值观数据集统一成可直接用于 instruction tuning 的指令-回复格式，并探索与通用指令数据混训时的配比影响。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练数据工程：提供一个“价值观指令数据”的统一入口，并给出混训不显著伤害通用能力的初步证据；对pretrain的价值主要在于对齐数据配比与污染风险的经验信号。
summary.technical_approach: 从多个既有 moral-value 数据集出发，做合并、去重/规范化（以摘要信息为准）、并统一转换为 instruction-response；训练时将该数据与通用任务指令数据按不同比例混合，观察价值导向任务与通用任务的权衡。
summary.experiments: 报告：混合通用指令数据+该道德价值数据可在保持通用任务表现的同时提升价值相关任务；并给出 mixing ratio 对价值任务表现的初步影响（摘要未给出模型规模、具体基线与数值）。

summary_en.core_problem: Unify disparate moral/value datasets into an instruction-response corpus and study how mixing ratios with general instruction data affect value-oriented vs general performance.
summary_en.importance: Post-training data contribution: a consolidated entry point for value-alignment instruction tuning, with preliminary evidence that mixing can preserve general capability; pretraining relevance is indirect (data mixture / alignment signal quality).
summary_en.technical_approach: Merge existing moral-value datasets, normalize them, and convert into a unified instruction-response format; run instruction tuning with mixed general-task instruction data under different mixing ratios.
summary_en.experiments: They report mixed training preserves general-task performance while improving value-oriented tasks, and provide preliminary observations on sensitivity to mixing ratio (no full scale/baseline numbers in abstract).

recommendation.zh: 当作“对齐数据配比”案例库即可：看它怎么统一格式、怎么做混训配比；但缺少干净的基线与规模细节，结论只能当弱经验信号。
recommendation.en: Use it as a data-mixture case study for value-alignment SFT (format unification + mixing ratios); without clean baselines and scale details, treat the reported trade-offs as weak evidence.

paper.title: Solar Open 2 Technical Report
paper.abstract: We present Solar Open 2, a 250B-A15B Mixture-of-Experts language model built for long-horizon agentic tasks, scaled up from Solar Open 1 (Solar Open 100B). To hold entire agent trajectories in a single context, Solar Open 2 reaches a 1M-token window through a hybrid attention stack that interleaves one softmax layer among every three linear-attention layers, using no positional encoding and a gated delta rule extended to negative eigenvalues. To train at this scale under a fixed compute budget,

summary.core_problem: 在固定计算预算下训练一个面向长程agent任务的250B-A15B MoE语言模型，并把上下文窗口扩到1M token。
summary.importance: 这是一个大模型技术报告，价值主要在三点：长上下文架构、跨架构初始化、以及按token价值做预训练数据筛选和配比。它直接触及预训练研究中的架构-数据-计算预算取舍。
summary.technical_approach: Solar Open 2采用混合注意力栈：每三个线性注意力层插入一个softmax注意力层，不使用位置编码，并把gated delta rule扩展到负特征值场景。训练上从Solar Open 1迁移5.69B共享骨架参数，其余部分继续完整预训练。数据上从20T token池中做质量、稀有度感知筛选和mixture-ratio优化，形成10T token训练混合。
summary.experiments: 模型规模为250B总参数、15B激活参数，目标上下文长度为1M token。摘要称10T高价值混合在相同token预算下优于未说明的对照混合，并以Solar Open 1作为起点；具体benchmark、消融和长上下文稳定性结果需要看正文表格。

summary_en.core_problem: The report describes how to train a 250B-A15B MoE language model for long-horizon agentic workloads with a 1M-token context window under a fixed compute budget.
summary_en.importance: The main value is the combination of long-context architecture, cross-architecture warm start, and value-per-token data curation. These are central pretraining tradeoffs rather than downstream tuning details.
summary_en.technical_approach: Solar Open 2 uses a hybrid attention stack with one softmax attention layer interleaved after every three linear-attention layers, no positional encoding, and a gated delta rule extended to negative eigenvalues. It initializes the 5.69B-parameter shared skeleton from Solar Open 1 and pretrains the remaining parameters. Its data pipeline refines a 20T-token pool into a 10T-token mixture using quality, rarity, and mixture-ratio optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The model is reported as 250B total parameters with 15B active parameters and a 1M-token context length. The abstract claims that the curated 10T-token mixture outperforms alternatives at equal token budget, but detailed benchmark numbers and ablations are not present in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 应看架构和数据消融：1M上下文若能靠3:1线性/softmax混合稳住，值得立刻纳入内部长上下文预训练对照。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture and data ablations: if the 3:1 linear/softmax stack really holds at 1M context, it belongs in internal long-context pretraining comparisons.

paper.title: Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0: Efficient Physical-World Agents
paper.abstract: Building capable embodied agents requires not only multimodal perception and understanding, but also agentic capabilities for reasoning about actions, adapting to evolving situations, and interacting with the physical world. In this report, we introduce Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0, an efficient and powerful embodied foundation model specifically designed for embodied agents operating in the physical world. To cultivate such capabilities from the pre-training stage onward, we define an action-centric cap

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是通用 VLM 的感知问答，而是“物理世界 agent 需要什么能力、如何把这些能力系统地灌进一个高效模型里”。更具体地说，作者面对的是 embodied 场景里常见的断层：普通 VLM 能看懂图像、能做一些语言推理，但对动作相关状态、环境变化、交互后果、长时序修复与恢复这几类能力支持不足，导致模型难以稳定迁移到导航、操作、交互式决策等真实物理任务中。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要不在某个单点算法，而在“能力 taxonomy → 数据构造 → 训练配比 → 评测闭环”这一整套方法。它把 embodied 预训练从泛化的图文理解，推进到动作中心的能力建模。对做多模态预训练的人，价值有三点：第一，说明物理世界 agent 的数据组织不能只靠堆图文对，必须围绕 action-relevant state、transition、sequential adaptation 分层设计；第二，说明高效 MoE VLM 可以在较低激活参数下保留较强 embodied 能力，这对部署敏感场景有现实意义；第三，它把 benchmark 设计和训练目标对齐得比较紧，适合作为后续做 native multimodal / embodied pretrain 时的参考框架。若只从纯文本 LLM 角度看，这篇论文不是核心必读；但从统一多模态基座、物理世界预训练和 post-train 接口角度看，它有方法论价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有两条主线。第一条是能力分层驱动的数据与训练设计。作者提出三层 taxonomy：Action-Relevant State Understanding、Action-Transition Reasoning、Sequential and Adaptive Reasoning。第一层覆盖物体/部件/属性/状态、深度与度量、3D 结构、视角与位姿、机器人中心线索、affordance 等；第二层强调动作理解、局部状态转移、交互后果和物理约束；第三层处理长时序规划、导航、反思、修复和恢复。这个 taxonomy 不是只拿来写 benchmark，而是直接指导 pre-training 与 post-training 的数据管线和 mixture 设计。也就是说，作者试图把“需要什么能力”前置到数据生产与配比，而不是训练完再靠下游补洞。

第二条是模型架构与效率设计。Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 采用 Hy3-A3B 语言骨干和 Hy-ViT2 视觉编码器，并使用 MoE 架构来控制推理成本。文中强调只有 3B activated parameters，但整体能力接近上一代更大的 A32B 方案，说明它更像是在总参数和激活参数之间做了面向部署的折中。这里的关键不是 MoE 本身新，而是把 MoE 放在 embodied VLM 上，目标明确指向低延迟 physical-world agent。与很多只追求离线 benchmark 的 embodied 模型不同，这篇工作从一开始就把 latency-sensitive deployment 作为约束。

从全文给出的信息看，作者还把训练分成 pre-train 和 post-train 两段，并用 taxonomy 去约束数据混合。虽然公开内容里没有把每一类数据规模、采样权重、课程策略完全展开到可复现程度，但可以看出他们不是简单拼接现成 VQA、导航、机器人数据，而是在能力层级上做覆盖和配平。这一点比单纯报一个总 token 数更有信息量。它隐含的判断是：embodied 能力缺口首先是训练信号结构问题，其次才是模型容量问题。
summary.experiments:
实验部分最重要的是评测覆盖和效率对比。作者把评测扩展到 38 个 benchmark，覆盖三层能力 taxonomy。与同规模近期模型 Qwen3.6-A3B、NVIDIA Cosmos 3-8B、Embodied-R1.5-8B 对比时，Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 在 38 个 benchmark 中有 19 个第一、11 个第二，三类能力平均分也最高，平均领先最强对手 Qwen3.6-A3B 4.4%。相对上一代 Hy-Embodied-0.5 MoT-2B，平均提升 8.4%。

效率是另一个关键数字。文中强调该模型仅用 3B 激活参数，约为上一代 A32B 的十分之一，但整体性能接近。这说明作者在 embodied 场景下把“能力/时延/激活开销”三者做了比较有效的平衡。对真实机器人或交互系统，这比单纯扩大总参数更有意义。

在更接近 agent 的任务上，作者还评测了视觉语言导航。R2R-CE 上，在 RGB-only 设置下达到当时最优；在 Matterport3D Object Goal Navigation 上表现出较强 zero-shot 能力。这里值得注意的是，导航结果被作者当作 taxonomy 第三层能力的外部验证：如果模型真的学到了动作序列、环境反馈和恢复能力，它应该能迁移到更强交互性的环境中，而不只是做静态图像问答。

不过从预训练研究者角度，也要看到实验的边界。文中给了总体平均提升和 benchmark 排名，但若想判断“到底是 taxonomy 数据设计起主要作用，还是 backbone / MoE / post-train 起主要作用”，还需要更细的消融，例如不同能力层数据去除、pre/post 比例变化、MoE 与 dense 对照、导航能力对静态数据比例的敏感性等。公开内容里这部分信息有限。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先抓三处。第一看 Introduction 和 Figure 2，对三层 capability taxonomy 建立清晰心智模型。这是全文真正的主轴。第二看 Data and Taxonomy 部分，重点不是记子任务名，而是看作者如何把能力定义映射到数据构造与 mixture；如果你做多模态预训练，这部分最有参考价值。第三看实验总表和导航实验，关注两件事：一是 38 个 benchmark 的覆盖是否真的对应 taxonomy；二是 3B activated parameters 与上一代大模型的效率对比。

如果阅读时间有限，30 分钟内可以完成一轮泛读：Introduction、taxonomy 图、主实验表、导航结果、结论。若要深挖，建议带着两个问题读：作者的数据 mixture 到底在补什么能力缺口；MoE 在 embodied 场景里是单纯省算力，还是也改变了能力分工。真正值得深挖的点不是某个 benchmark 分数，而是这套“能力定义先行”的训练组织方式能否迁移到更广义的 native multimodal pretrain。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about generic VLM perception or visual QA. It targets a more specific gap: what capabilities a physical-world agent actually needs, and how to train an efficient foundation model around those capabilities. The central issue is that standard VLMs can perceive and answer, but they are weak at action-relevant state understanding, reasoning over environment transitions, and maintaining adaptive behavior over long interaction horizons. That gap limits transfer to navigation, manipulation, and embodied decision-making.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining research is methodological rather than algorithmic. The paper builds a fairly explicit loop from capability taxonomy to data construction, training mixture, and evaluation. That is useful for anyone working on multimodal pretraining beyond static image-text alignment. Three takeaways matter. First, embodied pretraining cannot be reduced to scaling generic image-text corpora; the data has to be organized around action-relevant state, transitions, and sequential adaptation. Second, an MoE VLM with low activated parameters can still retain strong embodied competence, which matters for latency-constrained deployment. Third, the evaluation suite is aligned with the training taxonomy, making the work a practical template for native multimodal or embodied foundation model development. For pure text pretraining this is peripheral; for unified multimodal pretraining it is relevant.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two main components. The first is a capability-driven data and training design. The authors define a three-level taxonomy: Action-Relevant State Understanding, Action-Transition Reasoning, and Sequential and Adaptive Reasoning. The first level covers object parts, attributes, states, depth, metric estimation, 3D structure, viewpoint and pose, robot-centric cues, and affordances. The second level focuses on actions, local state transitions, interaction consequences, and physical constraints. The third level moves to long-horizon planning, navigation, reflection, repair, and recovery. Importantly, this taxonomy is not only used for evaluation. It is used to guide both pre-training and post-training data pipelines and mixtures.

The second component is the model design. Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 combines the Hy3-A3B language backbone with the Hy-ViT2 vision encoder and adopts an MoE architecture to keep inference efficient. The paper emphasizes 3B activated parameters while maintaining performance close to a much larger previous-generation system. The architectural novelty is limited in isolation, but the design choice is deliberate: the model is built for embodied deployment where latency matters.

From the full text, the training recipe appears to be split into pre-training and post-training stages, both informed by the taxonomy. The paper does not fully expose all mixture ratios or data scales at a level that would make the pipeline fully reproducible, but the intent is clear: the authors are not simply concatenating existing VQA, navigation, and robotics datasets. They are trying to balance training signals according to capability coverage. That is a meaningful design decision. It suggests that embodied performance bottlenecks are treated first as a training-signal organization problem, not only as a model-capacity problem.
summary_en.experiments:
The most important experimental contribution is the breadth of evaluation and the efficiency-performance trade-off. The model is evaluated on 38 benchmarks spanning the three capability levels. Against recent comparable-scale systems including Qwen3.6-A3B, NVIDIA Cosmos 3-8B, and Embodied-R1.5-8B, Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 ranks first on 19 benchmarks and second on 11. It also achieves the best average score across all three capability categories, outperforming the strongest competitor, Qwen3.6-A3B, by 4.4% on average. Relative to Hy-Embodied-0.5 MoT-2B, the average gain is 8.4%.

Efficiency is another key result. The model uses only 3B activated parameters, roughly one tenth of the previous A32B system, while delivering nearly comparable overall performance. For embodied systems, that is more informative than total parameter count alone.

The paper also evaluates on vision-and-language navigation tasks. On R2R-CE, it reports the best result in the RGB-only setting. On Matterport3D Object Goal Navigation, it shows strong zero-shot transfer. These results are used as evidence that the model is not only improving on static perception benchmarks but is also learning capabilities related to sequential interaction and adaptation.

That said, from a pretraining perspective, the ablation story appears incomplete in the public text. The paper reports strong aggregate gains, but it is harder to isolate how much comes from the taxonomy-driven data design versus the backbone, the MoE architecture, or post-training. More granular ablations on data mixture, capability-level removal, dense versus MoE, and pretrain/post-train balance would have made the causal picture clearer.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick pass, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the taxonomy figure carefully. That is the conceptual center of the paper. Second, read the Data and Taxonomy section with attention to how capability definitions are translated into data construction and mixture design. That is the most useful part for multimodal pretraining researchers. Third, inspect the main benchmark table and the navigation results, especially the relation between benchmark coverage and the three capability levels, and the comparison between 3B activated parameters and the previous larger model.

A 30-minute skim is enough to extract the main ideas: introduction, taxonomy figure, main results table, navigation section, and conclusion. If reading more deeply, keep two questions in mind. What capability gaps is the data mixture trying to close? And in this setting, is MoE only reducing compute, or is it also enabling a more useful specialization pattern for embodied reasoning? The most interesting part is not any single benchmark score, but the training organization principle behind the model.

recommendation.zh: 只看 taxonomy 和 data mixture 章节；3B 级 embodied VLM 的取舍有参考，benchmark 结论别当 scaling 信号。
recommendation.en: Read the taxonomy and data-mixture sections; the 3B embodied-VLM trade-offs are useful, but do not treat the benchmarks as scaling evidence.

paper.title: Domain-Aware Scaling Laws Uncover Data Synergy
paper.abstract: Machine learning progress is often attributed to scaling model size and dataset volume, yet the composition of data can be just as consequential. Empirical findings repeatedly show that combining datasets from different domains yields nontrivial interactions. For instance, adding code improves mathematical reasoning, while certain mixtures introduce interference that reduces model performance. We refer to these effects collectively as data synergy, where the contribution of multiple domains exce

summary.core_problem: 建立面向语言模型预训练数据配比的 domain-aware scaling law，用来量化不同数据域之间的正向协同和负向干扰。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 scaling law 与数据配比方法论。它把 data mixture 从经验调参推进到可估计的直接域贡献和二阶域-域协同，对预训练配方设计、数据预算分配和 benchmark 预测都有直接意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文利用开源权重 LLM 在不同预训练数据混合上的观测差异，估计两类效应：direct domain-to-benchmark synergy，即某一数据域对另一类 benchmark 表现的贡献；second-order domain-domain synergy，即能力需要多个数据域共同出现时产生的交互项。方法上不是只看总 token 数或单域 token 数，而是显式建模数据域之间的非加性项，以提升性能预测。
summary.experiments: 实验基于预训练数据混合不同的 open-weight LLM 观测数据，比较 domain-aware synergy 模型与不含交互项的预测基线。摘要明确称该框架提升了预测准确率，并能识别代码提升数学推理、某些混合造成干扰等现象；具体模型数量、域划分、benchmark 集合和提升幅度需看正文表格。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 MIT CSAIL、Microsoft Research 和 Harvard University。Lester Mackey 是 Microsoft Research 的知名机器学习研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper develops domain-aware scaling laws for language-model pretraining mixtures, with the goal of quantifying positive synergy and negative interference among data domains.
summary_en.importance: This is a scaling-law and data-mixture methodology contribution. It moves mixture design beyond aggregate token counts by estimating direct domain effects and second-order domain-domain interactions, which is directly useful for pretraining data allocation and benchmark prediction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework leverages observational variation across open-weight LLMs with diverse pretraining mixtures. It estimates direct domain-to-benchmark synergy, where one domain contributes to performance on another, and second-order domain-domain synergy, where capabilities arise from the co-occurrence of multiple domains. The key modeling choice is to include non-additive interaction terms among domains rather than only total tokens or independent domain volumes.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use open-weight LLMs with varied pretraining mixtures and compare the proposed domain-aware synergy model against predictive baselines without such interaction terms. The abstract reports improved predictive accuracy and captures examples such as code helping mathematical reasoning and some mixtures causing interference. Exact model counts, domain taxonomies, benchmark sets, and numerical gains require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with MIT CSAIL, Microsoft Research, and Harvard University. Lester Mackey is a well-known machine learning researcher at Microsoft Research.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看模型设定和残差分析；若交互项稳健，data mixture ablation 不能再只报单域 token 边际收益。
recommendation.en: Read the model specification and residual analysis first; if the interactions hold, mixture ablations should stop reporting only marginal single-domain token effects.

paper.title: HERMES: A Multi-Granularity Labeling Substrate for Pre-training Data Mixtures
paper.abstract: Most data-mixing methods assume the corpus has already been partitioned into groups, and the choice of those groups determines what a mixer can express. Existing labels, including provenance, topic or format taxonomies, and flat embedding clusters, commit to one semantic axis at one granularity; changing the resolution rebuilds the labels. We argue the bottleneck is the label system, not the mixer, and provide a hierarchical one. HERMES is a data-derived labeling substrate: a Learned Semantic Tr

summary.core_problem: HERMES 解决的是预训练数据 mixture 中“标签系统”不够灵活的问题。很多数据混合方法默认语料已经被分好组，但分组方式决定了 mixer 能表达什么。来源标签太粗，人工 taxonomy 只能沿一个语义轴划分，普通 embedding clustering 又是固定 K 的平面划分，想换粒度就要重新聚类。HERMES 把问题转到一次性、多粒度、层级化的数据标注：每篇文档只标一次，之后通过 code prefix 改变粒度。
summary.importance: 这是一篇预训练数据方向的工作，贡献点在 label substrate，而不是新的 sampler。它的实际意义在于把“数据分组”从单次工程选择变成可调旋钮。对大规模预训练来说，这很关键：RegMix、Data Mixing Laws 这类回归式 mixer 在十万级 cell 上代价很高；逐文档 selector 又需要 web-scale per-document compute。HERMES 处在中间位置，用离线 embedding 和层级 RVQ 给约 5000 万文档打标签，支持从 256 个 coarse buckets 到约 6.5 万、约 13 万 observed cells 的粒度扫描。更重要的是，它展示了 granularity 与 Stage-2 sampler 会相互作用：在 L12 粒度下质量筛选有效，在 L123 粒度下同样思路几乎失效。这对数据配比研究很有提醒意义，不能把“更细粒度分组”和“更强质量过滤”简单当作单调收益。
summary.technical_approach: HERMES 的输入是冻结 encoder 产生的文档 embedding，维度 d=1024，规模约 N=5×10^7。系统由两部分组成。第一部分是 Learned Semantic Transform，形式是 linear-plus-normalize：h_i = normalize(W e_i + b)，W 从 identity 初始化。它的目标不是学习新的语义模型，而是把 embedding 旋转到更适合量化的空间。训练时使用三类约束：pairwise structure preservation 保持原 embedding 的局部/全局关系，quantization-aware reconstruction 让变换后的表示更容易被 codebook 重构，orthogonality 约束避免线性变换退化。第二部分是 3-stage residual vector quantization，每一层 codebook 大小 K=256。第一层给出 c1，第二、三层依次量化残差，得到 (c1, c2, c3)。prefix 就是粒度控制：L1=c1 对应 256 个 buckets；L12=(c1,c2) 对应约 6.5 万 buckets；L123=(c1,c2,c3) 在实际语料中观察到约 13 万 cells。由于所有粒度来自同一套 codebook，比较不同 sampler 时不会混入“重新聚类导致分组变化”的因素。训练和采样上，外层权重只在 L1 级别使用 Uniform 或 DoReMi，避免在十万级 cell 上拟合高维 mixer。Stage-2 在每个 coarse bucket 内决定如何取文档：一种是 max-entropy coverage，尽量让 sub-bucket mass 更均匀并保留全部文档；另一种是 quality top-30%，按质量 reader 在候选内取前 30%，质量 reader 使用修正后的 FineWeb-Edu reader。论文还设计了 quota-preserving 的 L123 对照，用 per-L1 local random coverage 对比 L123 quality top-30%，把外层 quota 固定住，隔离细粒度下候选竞争的影响。
summary.experiments: 实验规模是 1B 参数量模型、25B token 训练预算，评测使用 16 个任务的 capability macro-mean Avg.。首先，HERMES 并不声称自己在 K=256 上是更好的聚类算法。Table 2 显示它在 compactness 和 mass-balance 等标准聚类指标上与四种 256-way clusterer 处在同一平台；下游训练结果也与 KMeans 几乎持平，Avg. 差距在 0.0002 内。关键实验是 sampler 与粒度的受控比较。Finding A：在固定 corpus、model、codebook、outer weight 和 L12 粒度下，DoReMi-L1 外层权重不变，把 Stage-2 从 max-entropy coverage 切到 quality top-30%，16-task Avg. 提升 +0.0253，z=+2.09。这说明在 L12 的候选池大小下，质量 reader 的排序信号仍能转化成预训练收益。Finding B：同样的优势在 L123 粒度下消失。用 quota-preserving 对照比较 per-L1 L123 local random coverage 与 L123 quality top-30%，Avg. 分别为 0.3986 和 0.3988，差值只有 +0.0002，单 seed 下可视为数值持平。论文给出的诊断是 candidate competition：从 L12 到 L123，median candidate pool 从 2271 缩到 429，缩小 5.3 倍；当每个细粒度 cell 的候选太少时，局部 top-30% 排序不再稳定代表全局质量排序。这个结果比单纯报告某个 mixture 最优更有价值，因为它解释了为什么质量过滤在不同标签粒度下会出现不同收益。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Introduction，抓住它把问题拆成 label system 与 mixer 两层的设定；这个拆分决定了后面所有实验的解释方式。然后看 Method 中 LST 与 RVQ 的构造，重点是为什么用 rotate-then-quantize，而不是直接 KMeans 或固定 taxonomy；Appendix D 的 loss 设计和训练细节值得跟一下，尤其是结构保持、量化重构和正交约束如何共同服务于可量化语义空间。Section 5.1 和 Table 2 要看，它们说明 HERMES 的目标不是赢聚类指标，而是提供同一 annotation 下的粒度旋钮。Section 5.2 是主要正结果，关注 L12 下 Stage-2 sampler 的受控比较。Section 5.3 是更有研究价值的部分，说明细粒度并不自动增强质量筛选，candidate pool size 会改变 sampler 的有效性。若做数据配比或数据选择，建议继续看 Appendix L 中 Uniform 与 DoReMi-L1 的配对分析，判断外层 mixture weight 与内层文档选择是否有耦合。需要注意单 seed 训练会限制统计强度，但实验控制做得比较清楚，结论适合转化为后续大规模 ablation 的设计原则。

summary_en.core_problem: HERMES targets the labeling bottleneck in pretraining data mixtures. Most mixing methods assume that the corpus has already been partitioned, but the partition itself limits what the mixer can express. Provenance labels are coarse, hand-built taxonomies fix one semantic axis, and flat embedding clusters must be recomputed when the desired resolution changes. HERMES provides a one-shot hierarchical labeling substrate: each document receives a coarse-to-fine code once, and the prefix length controls the mixture granularity.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a data-labeling substrate for pretraining, not a new mixture optimizer. This distinction matters. Regression-style mixture optimizers become costly when the number of cells grows to tens or hundreds of thousands, while per-document selectors require expensive compute at web scale. HERMES occupies a practical middle ground: offline annotation over roughly 50 million documents, with a usable granularity dial from 256 coarse buckets to about 65k and 130k observed cells. The most informative result is not that HERMES beats clustering at a fixed K. It does not claim that. The useful finding is that granularity and the within-bucket sampler interact. Quality filtering helps at the L12 level, but the same idea nearly vanishes at L123 because candidate pools become too small. This is directly relevant to data-mixture research: finer labels and stronger filtering do not guarantee monotonic gains.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system starts from frozen document embeddings with dimension 1024 over about 5×10^7 documents. HERMES first applies a Learned Semantic Transform, h_i = normalize(W e_i + b), with W initialized as the identity. The transform is trained to make the embedding space more quantization-friendly while preserving semantic structure. The losses include pairwise structure preservation, quantization-aware reconstruction, and an orthogonality constraint to avoid degenerate rotations. A three-stage residual vector quantizer then emits a code (c1, c2, c3), with codebook size K=256 at every stage. The first stage gives L1 buckets, the first two stages give L12 buckets, and all three stages give L123 buckets. In the observed corpus this corresponds to 256 buckets, roughly 65k buckets, and roughly 130k cells. Since all resolutions come from the same trained codebook stack, changes in downstream behavior can be attributed to granularity and sampling rules rather than to different reclustering runs. For training mixtures, the outer weights are kept at the L1 level using Uniform or DoReMi, which avoids fitting a high-dimensional mixer over tens of thousands of cells. The Stage-2 sampler controls which documents are drawn within the coarse buckets. The key comparison is between max-entropy coverage, which spreads mass across sub-buckets and keeps all documents eligible, and quality top-30%, which uses a corrected FineWeb-Edu reader to select the top 30% within the relevant candidate sets. A quota-preserving L123 comparison is added to isolate the effect of candidate competition under finer cells.
summary_en.experiments: The downstream study uses a 1B-parameter model trained for 25B tokens and evaluates a 16-task capability macro-average. At K=256, HERMES is on the same plateau as four standard 256-way clusterers on compactness and mass-balance metrics. It is also essentially matched to KMeans in downstream performance, within 0.0002 Avg. The main controlled experiment is at L12 under fixed corpus, model, codebook, outer weight, and granularity. With DoReMi-L1 outer weights, switching Stage-2 from max-entropy coverage to quality top-30% improves Avg. by +0.0253, with z=+2.09. The finer-granularity result changes the story. Under a quota-preserving L123 setup, per-L1 local random coverage scores 0.3986 and L123 quality top-30% scores 0.3988, a difference of only +0.0002 under single-seed evaluation. The proposed explanation is candidate competition: the median candidate pool shrinks from 2,271 documents at L12 to 429 at L123, a 5.3× reduction. Once the candidate set becomes small, within-cell quality ranking becomes a weaker proxy for global document quality. This is the strongest experimental insight in the work.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it carefully if working on pretraining data mixtures. Start with the framing that separates the label system from the mixer; it is the key design choice.
