summary.core_problem: 论文研究的是在高能物理模拟数据场景下，能否通过设计预训练数据组成来改变 scaling law 的形状和 compute-optimal 方向。具体任务是 hadronic jet 分类：固定下游任务，改变 JetClass-II 预训练子集里的物理过程组成，观察模型大小、预训练数据组成和微调性能之间的幂律关系。
summary.importance: 这不是 LLM 论文，领域任务也较窄；对基座预训练的价值在于数据组成与 scaling behavior 的关系。它把“数据更多”拆成更具体的问题：预训练数据是否覆盖更宽的生成过程，是否与下游任务的有效特征对齐。这个视角可以类比到语言模型的数据配比：不同语料不只是改变平均质量，也可能改变 scaling exponent、数据受限还是参数受限的最优区间，以及微调阶段对参数量和数据量的依赖。需要注意，论文中的数据来自可控物理模拟，和自然语言网页语料的采样约束不同，结论不能直接迁移。
summary.technical_approach: 方法使用一个处理 jet point cloud 的通用 Transformer。每个 jet 由 constituent particles 构成，每个粒子包含 4 个运动学特征、4 个轨迹位移特征和 1 个粒子 ID 特征。模型使用 learnable class token、pre-norm Transformer blocks、SwiGLU FFN，不使用位置编码，因为输入是集合而不是序列。模型深度固定为 4 层，attention head dimension 固定为 8，通过改变 embedding dimension 和 head 数得到 12 个模型规模，参数量约从 3K 到 10.5M。预训练数据来自 JetClass-II，共 188 类模拟 jet，分为 QCD、BSM two-prong resonance decay、BSM three/four-prong resonance decay 三组。论文构造四个预训练子集：QCD only、QCD+res2p、QCD+res34p、QCD+res2p+res34p。下游任务是在 JetClass 上做 10 类 jet 分类。核心设计是用 BSM resonance decay 增加预训练数据的 diversity 和 alignment：它们覆盖 QCD 不覆盖的相空间，并在 prong multiplicity、mass scale、substructure 等特征上更接近下游任务。
summary.experiments: 实验扫描 12 个模型规模和多种预训练数据组成，在 JetClass-II 上预训练后，在 JetClass 10 类分类任务上微调，并拟合性能随模型规模和数据组成变化的 scaling behavior。给定正文明确给出了模型规模范围、数据桶和预训练子集设计，但没有提供结果表格里的具体数值、拟合指数或误差下降幅度。可归纳的实验结论是：加入 BSM resonance decay 的预训练子集通过增加多样性和任务相关性，能够改变 fine-tuning scaling 的趋势，使 compute-optimal 分配更偏向使用数据，而不是单纯扩大模型。论文也承认当前实验没有分离 diversity 和 alignment 两个因素，因为 BSM-augmented 数据同时带来更宽支持集和更强下游相关性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 15–25 分钟。LLM 研究者不需要细读物理背景，重点看 Introduction 里关于 engineering scaling laws 的问题设定，以及 Methods 里四个预训练子集如何定义 diversity 和 alignment。实验部分优先看 scaling fits、不同数据组成的性能曲线、compute-optimal 讨论。如果关心数据配比研究，可以重点关注作者如何把“数据组成”转化为可控变量；如果只关心通用 LLM 预训练，这篇可以作为方法类旁证，不需要深读物理任务细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether scaling behavior can be engineered by changing the composition of pretraining data. The study is set in hadronic jet classification, where high-fidelity simulators make it cheap to generate controlled pretraining corpora. The concrete question is how different JetClass-II pretraining mixtures affect the scaling relation between model size, data composition, and downstream fine-tuning performance on JetClass.
summary_en.importance: This is a physics-domain study rather than an LLM pretraining paper, so its direct relevance is limited. The useful idea is that data composition can change not only the intercept of a scaling curve but also the regime in which more data or more parameters are preferred. For LLM pretraining, the analogue would be mixtures whose diversity and task alignment affect scaling exponents, downstream transfer, and compute-optimal allocation. The caveat is important: particle physics has controllable synthetic data generation, while language pretraining usually depends on messy, naturally occurring corpora.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model is a Transformer over jet point clouds. Each jet is represented as a set of constituent particles, with kinematic features, trajectory displacement features, and particle identification features. The architecture uses a learnable class token, pre-norm Transformer blocks, SwiGLU feed-forward layers, and no positional encodings because the input is a set. Depth is fixed at four layers and the attention head dimension is fixed at eight; embedding width and number of heads are varied to obtain 12 model sizes from roughly 3K to 10.5M parameters. Pretraining uses JetClass-II, which contains 188 simulated jet classes grouped into QCD, two-prong BSM resonance decays, and three/four-prong BSM resonance decays. Four pretraining subsets are compared: QCD only, QCD plus res2p, QCD plus res34p, and the union of all three groups. The downstream task is 10-class jet classification on JetClass. The main design choice is to use BSM resonance decays as a controlled way to increase both distributional diversity and alignment with downstream substructure features.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments sweep model size and pretraining composition, then fine-tune on the JetClass classification task and analyze scaling trends. The available text gives the parameter range, architecture, data buckets, and mixture definitions, but not the exact fitted exponents or numerical performance gains. The reported qualitative result is that BSM-augmented pretraining mixtures alter the scaling behavior and move the preferred allocation toward data-rich regimes. The study also notes a limitation: diversity and alignment are not disentangled, because the BSM additions simultaneously broaden the pretraining support and improve feature overlap with the downstream task.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. For LLM pretraining readers, the useful parts are the introduction’s framing of engineered scaling laws and the methods section defining the four controlled data mixtures. In the results, focus on the scaling fits, mixture comparisons, and compute-allocation discussion. The particle-physics details can be read lightly unless you need to evaluate whether the claimed diversity and alignment variables are well controlled.

recommendation.zh: 数据组成可改变scaling幂律斜率的结论对LLM数据配比设计有直接参考，重点看数据组成调控scaling的实验部分。
recommendation.en: The finding that data composition shifts scaling law exponents is directly relevant to LLM data mixture design; focus on the data-modulated scaling experiments.

paper.title: RegMix-D: Dynamic Data Mixing via Proxy Training Trajectories
paper.abstract: Data mixture selection is critical for Large Language Model pretraining. Existing methods such as RegMix select a single static mixture by fitting a regression model on small-scale proxy runs. We propose RegMix-D, a simple extension of RegMix to dynamic mixing. Our key observation is that proxy runs produce not only endpoint losses, but also full loss trajectories, which can be used to further improve data mixture. By training regression model on these trajectories, we can predict optimal mixtur

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是预训练数据配比里的一个老问题：不同语料域的最优 mixture 并不是整个训练过程都不变，但现有像 RegMix 这样的做法只用 proxy run 的终点 loss 去选一个静态配比，等于默认“全程一个最优解”。作者要做的是在不引入复杂额外训练机制的前提下，把 proxy 训练轨迹里的时序信息利用起来，得到随训练阶段变化的动态 data mixture schedule。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义比较直接，而且量级不小。数据混合比例本来就是 pretrain recipe 里影响很大的自由度，但过去自动化方法大多停留在 static mixture。RegMix-D 的贡献在于证明：只要把 proxy run 从“一个终点样本”改成“多段轨迹样本”，就能在几乎不改变 RegMix 框架的情况下，把静态 mixture 搜索扩展成动态调度，而且还能降低 proxy compute 需求。它不是提出新的优化目标，也不是靠额外 teacher/reference model 做复杂控制，而是把已有 proxy 预算里的信息榨得更干净。这对大规模预训练很有现实意义，因为它同时碰到了两个核心点：data curriculum 和 proxy-based recipe search。
summary.technical_approach:
方法很简洁，关键是把回归目标从“mixture -> 最终 loss”改成“当前训练状态 -> 下一阶段 loss”。RegMix 原始做法是：采样若干 mixture，训练若干小 proxy 模型到固定步数，只记录终点验证损失，再拟合一个回归器预测某个 mixture 的终点 loss，最后选一个全程固定的 mixture。RegMix-D 则在 proxy 训练中按多个时间点记录 validation loss，把每条 proxy trajectory 切成若干相邻区间。对于给定的 switch point 数 N，会选出 N+1 个时间节点 t1...tN+1，并从每条轨迹构造 M×N 个训练样本。回归器 f_N 的输入是当前步点 t_l、当前 mixture m、当前 observed loss l_l，输出是下一时间点的 loss l_{l+1}。也就是说，它学的是局部转移，而不是全局终点映射。

在部署上有两个版本。Offline 版本在目标训练开始前递归生成完整 schedule：从初始 loss 出发，在每个 switch point 上搜索使预测下一段 loss 最低的 mixture，把预测出的 loss 再喂给下一段，直到生成整条 mixture schedule。这个版本不需要 target run 中途干预，但误差会递归累积。Online 版本则在 target training 的每个 switch point 上，用目标模型真实观测到的 validation loss 替代预测 loss，再调用同一个冻结回归器选择下一段 mixture。这样做的好处是把 proxy-to-target 的偏差限制在单段决策里，而不是沿整条 schedule 传播。

方法上的几个细节值得注意。第一，作者没有引入额外 RL、bandit 或 bilevel optimization 机制，仍然是回归 + candidate search，所以工程接入成本低。第二，初始阶段固定使用 human-curated Pile prior，而不是从第一个 segment 就让回归器自由选 mixture，这反映了一个现实假设：训练初期没有足够 target-state 信息，先验配比更稳。第三，mixture 搜索仍然通过 Dirichlet-sampled candidates 完成，说明作者追求的是在现有 RegMix 搜索框架内最小改动地升级为 dynamic mixing，而不是重新设计连续优化器。
summary.experiments:
实验设置沿用 RegMix 标准配置：在 Pile 上做 25B tokens 训练，目标模型为 1B 参数。论文的核心比较对象是静态 RegMix 与动态 RegMix-D，在不同 switch granularity 下比较 offline 和 online 两种部署。主结论有三条。第一，RegMix-D 在所有测试粒度上都优于 RegMix，既体现在 validation loss，也体现在 13 个下游任务的平均表现。第二，online 版本通常比 offline 更稳，因为它用真实 target loss 校正状态，避免递归预测误差累积；offline 仍然有效，但更依赖回归器外推质量。第三，数据效率明显提升：只用 128 个 proxy models，也就是 RegMix 512 个 proxy 配置约 25% 的预算，就已经能超过后者。这一点很关键，因为 proxy-based mixture search 真正的瓶颈往往不是方法本身，而是前期试验成本。

从摘要和正文可见信息看，作者强调的是“一致优于”而不是某个单点大幅提升。更值得注意的是消融逻辑：性能提升来自轨迹监督带来的更好状态建模，而不是单纯因为用了更多 proxy 标签；因为同一条 proxy run 的中间 loss 被重复利用，单位 proxy compute 产出的监督信号更多。另一个重要观察是，动态 mixture 的收益在训练不同阶段并不均匀，这间接支持了作者的出发点：域最优配比确实会随训练进展变化，静态 mixture 只能做折中。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇建议精读。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，把问题框成“static mixture selection 不够，因为最优域配比会漂移”。然后重点读 RegMix-D 方法部分，尤其是训练样本构造、f_N 的输入输出定义、offline 递归生成 schedule 的过程，以及 online 如何用真实 loss 做状态校正。这里真正的创新不在模型形式，而在问题重写：把 mixture search 从一次性全局选择改成局部状态转移预测。实验部分优先看三类结果：一是 validation loss 曲线，确认动态调度是否稳定优于静态；二是 13 个下游任务总表，判断收益是否泛化；三是 proxy 数量消融，理解它为什么能用更少 proxy 超过 RegMix。若时间有限，先抓住 offline vs online 的差别，再看不同 switch point 数 N 的敏感性。值得深挖的点有四个：其一，回归器是否真正学到了“阶段性域需求”，还是只是在拟合 loss 平滑趋势；其二，switch granularity 过细时是否会引入 schedule 抖动；其三，proxy-to-target 缩放在更大模型、更长训练上是否仍成立；其四，初始使用 human prior 的设计是否可以被更系统的 cold-start 策略替代。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a central weakness in proxy-based data-mixture optimization for LLM pretraining: the best domain mixture is unlikely to stay constant throughout training, yet methods such as RegMix assume a single static optimum and fit regressors only on endpoint losses from proxy runs. RegMix-D turns the problem into dynamic mixture scheduling by exploiting the full loss trajectories already produced by those proxy runs.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to pretraining practice. Data mixture is one of the highest-leverage recipe choices, but most automated methods still search for one fixed mixture. RegMix-D shows that a dynamic schedule can be obtained with minimal changes to the existing RegMix pipeline, simply by using trajectory supervision instead of endpoint-only supervision. The practical significance is twofold: it improves target-model performance and reduces the amount of proxy compute needed to beat the static baseline. That makes it a meaningful contribution to data curriculum design and proxy-based recipe search.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The key move is to replace a global regression target with a local transition model. In standard RegMix, each sampled mixture is used to train one proxy model to a fixed horizon, only the final validation loss is kept, and a regressor maps mixture to endpoint loss. The chosen mixture is then used for the entire target run. RegMix-D logs validation loss at multiple points along each proxy trajectory. For a chosen number of switch points N, it selects N+1 time anchors and converts each proxy trajectory into M×N training examples. The regressor f_N takes the current state (training step t_l, current mixture m, current loss l_l) and predicts the next loss l_{l+1}. In other words, it learns one-step loss transitions rather than a direct mixture-to-final-loss map.

This enables two deployment modes. In the offline mode, the schedule is generated before target training: starting from an initial loss, the method searches over candidate mixtures at each switch point, picks the one with the lowest predicted next-step loss, feeds that predicted loss into the next decision, and recursively builds a full schedule. In the online mode, the same frozen regressor is queried during target training, but the current loss is the actually observed target-model validation loss rather than the previously predicted one. This grounds each decision in the real target trajectory and limits error accumulation.

Several design choices are worth noting. The method does not introduce RL, bandits, or bilevel optimization; it stays within the regression-plus-search framework, which keeps the engineering overhead low. The first segment uses the human-curated Pile prior instead of a learned mixture, reflecting a cold-start assumption that early in training there is not enough target-state information to trust dynamic adaptation. Candidate mixtures are still searched via Dirichlet sampling, so the contribution is a minimal but effective extension of RegMix rather than a full redesign of the optimizer.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments follow the standard RegMix setup: a 1B-parameter target model trained on 25B tokens from the Pile. The main comparisons are static RegMix versus RegMix-D, with both offline and online variants evaluated under different switching granularities. The headline findings are consistent. First, RegMix-D outperforms RegMix at every tested granularity, both in validation loss and across 13 downstream tasks. Second, the online variant is generally more reliable than the offline one because it uses observed target losses to correct the state, whereas the offline schedule can accumulate recursive prediction error. Third, the method is notably more proxy-efficient: 128 proxy models, about 25% of the 512-proxy budget used by RegMix, are already enough to surpass the static baseline.

The important experimental point is not one unusually large gain, but the consistency of the improvement. The ablation logic also matters: the benefit comes from extracting more supervision from the same proxy runs, not from adding a new expensive optimization loop. By reusing intermediate losses, each proxy run yields many local transition labels. Another useful observation is that the gains from dynamic mixing are not uniform across training, which supports the paper’s premise that the preferred domain composition shifts over time and cannot be captured well by a single static mixture.
summary_en.reading_guide: This one deserves a close read. Start with the introduction and Figure 1 to frame the problem correctly: static mixture selection is limited because the optimal domain composition drifts during training. Then focus on the RegMix-D section, especially how trajectory samples are constructed, what f_N predicts, how the offline recursive schedule is generated, and how the online variant replaces predicted losses with observed target losses. The main innovation is not a sophisticated model class; it is the reformulation of mixture search as local state-transition prediction. In the experiments, prioritize three pieces: validation-loss comparisons, the 13-task downstream table, and the proxy-budget ablation. If time is limited, first understand the offline-versus-online trade-off, then look at sensitivity to the number of switch points N. The deeper questions are whether the regressor is truly learning stage-dependent domain demand rather than just smoothing loss trends, whether very fine switching causes schedule instability, whether proxy-to-target transfer still holds at larger scales, and whether the human-prior cold start can be replaced by a more principled initialization strategy.

recommendation.zh: 应在内部 data-mixture ablation 里复现；重点看 trajectory 信号是否真能跨尺度迁移。
recommendation.en: Worth reproducing in internal data-mixture ablations; the key question is whether trajectory signals transfer cleanly across scale.

paper.title: FastMix: Fast Data Mixture Optimization via Gradient Descent
paper.abstract: While large and diverse datasets have driven recent advances in large models, identifying the optimal data mixture for pre-training and post-training remains a significant open problem. We address this challenge with FASTMIX, a novel framework that automates data mixture discovery while training only a single proxy model. Instead of relying on predefined heuristics or resource-intensive simulations, FASTMIX jointly optimizes mixture coefficients and model parameters, substantially improving effi

summary.core_problem: 预训练与后训练的数据 mixture 配比通常依赖启发式或多次重训搜索，成本极高，需要在单次代理模型训练内高效优化。
summary.importance: 把 data mixture 搜索明确写成双层优化，并推导出'按源均匀采样等价于按 mixture 系数做 per-source loss 重加权'的等价性，把 mixture 搜索变成端到端可微问题；是 data mixture 自动化方向的重要进展。
summary.technical_approach: FastMix 将 mixture 选择表述为 bilevel optimization；推导得到优化 mixture ratio 等价于在 uniform source sampling 下对每个 source 的 loss 赋权，从而可以在训练一个 proxy model 的过程中，用梯度同时更新模型参数和 mixture 系数，避免了多模型多次重跑。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验细节与具体模型/数据规模，但宣称显著优于依赖预定义启发式和多仿真的已有 mixture 搜索方法，在效率与可扩展性上提升明显。

summary_en.core_problem: Finding the optimal data mixture for pre-training and post-training is usually done by heuristics or costly repeated training runs.
summary_en.importance: Reformulates data mixture search as a bilevel optimization problem and shows an equivalence between optimizing mixture ratios and assigning per-source loss weights under uniform source sampling, turning mixture search into an end-to-end differentiable problem.
summary_en.technical_approach: FastMix jointly optimizes mixture coefficients and model parameters in a single proxy run: mixture ratios are embedded into a differentiable training objective via the derived reweighting equivalence, enabling gradient-based mixture updates without repeated full runs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims substantial efficiency and scalability gains over heuristic-based and simulation-heavy prior mixture optimization methods; full model and dataset details are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把 mixture search 从黑盒扫参变成可微双层优化，直接对应 data ratio 调参的真实痛点；应在内部小规模 proxy 上复现这个 reweighting 等价关系。
recommendation.en: Turns data-mixture search from black-box sweeps into differentiable bilevel optimization; worth reproducing the reweighting equivalence on an internal proxy setup.

paper.title: The Culture Funnel: You Can't Align What isn't in the Data
paper.abstract: Current cultural alignment approaches focus on inference-time interventions, assuming models already contain sufficient cultural knowledge. We argue modern LLM pipelines suffer from a cultural data funnel. Using a multidimensional tagging framework across pretraining, fine-tuning, alignment, and reasoning datasets, we show explicit cultural signals decline sharply during post-training, while geographically concentrated, task-specialized data dominates. Multilinguality enhances geographic diversi

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究文化对齐失败是否来自训练数据管线，而不是只来自推理时提示或对齐方法。核心观点是：预训练语料中可能存在一定文化信号，但经过 SFT、偏好对齐、推理数据和任务化数据筛选后，显式文化信息会被压缩，形成所谓 culture funnel。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据研究的启发比较明确。它把文化对齐从“模型有没有文化知识”转成“训练阶段是否给了模型足够、均衡、可学习的文化信号”。这对 data mixture、post-training 数据配比、合成推理数据污染都有意义。现在很多后训练数据强调数学、代码、推理和通用帮助性，容易把地域、生活方式、社会规范、价值偏好等信号稀释掉。多语数据可以增加地域覆盖，但不能自动保证文化覆盖均衡，这一点对 multilingual pretraining 和 instruction tuning 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 工作构建了一个自动文化标注管线，对 5.6M 条样本做多维标签。标签维度包括文化类型、领域、任务意图、地理位置和语言。文化标签采用面向 NLP 的 taxonomy，包含 Culture as Knowledge、Dynamics、Preference、Bias，并额外区分 General Culture 和 No Culture。语言识别使用 FastText LangID，其余标注主要使用 Command-A。预训练语料按整段文本标注；后训练和对话数据只标注用户侧 prompt 或 instruction，因为这些部分决定了模型是否有机会学习文化语境。数据选择覆盖预训练、后训练、评测和真实用户对话，包括 CulturaX、Dolci Instruct-SFT、GeoFact-X、CultureBank、MultiNRC、Aya 原创标注、PRISM 和 ShareLM 等。
summary.experiments: 实验结果显示，显式文化信号在训练管线后段明显下降，后训练数据更集中在少数地理区域和任务类型上。多语言数据提升了地理多样性，但语言不是文化的充分代理，仍会出现覆盖不均。工作还报告了一个实用结果：加入显式文化标签后，下游文化 benchmark 表现提升，说明文化标记不只是分析工具，也可以作为训练或数据筛选信号。需要注意的是，标注依赖自动模型，结论更适合作为大规模数据分布诊断，而不是对单条样本文化充分性的人工判定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。先看数据选择和 tagging taxonomy，确认它如何定义文化、地理位置、任务意图和语言。然后看各训练阶段的文化信号变化图表，这是主要结论来源。最后看文化标签用于下游 benchmark 的实验，判断这些标签是否能转化为训练收益。对做数据配比的人，重点不是具体 benchmark 分数，而是它提供了一种审计 post-training 数据的方式：检查指令数据、偏好数据和推理数据是否系统性稀释了文化语境。

summary_en.core_problem: The work asks whether failures in cultural alignment are caused by the training data pipeline rather than only by inference-time prompting or alignment methods. Its central claim is that cultural signals may exist in pretraining corpora, but are progressively compressed during SFT, alignment, reasoning-data construction, and task-specialized post-training.
summary_en.importance: The paper is most relevant as a pretraining and post-training data study. It reframes cultural alignment as a data-mixture and signal-preservation problem: models cannot reliably learn culturally situated behavior if the relevant contexts are sparse, geographically concentrated, or removed by later curation stages. This matters for multilingual pretraining, instruction tuning, synthetic reasoning data, and preference-data design. A useful point is that multilinguality improves geographic coverage but does not by itself provide balanced cultural representation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build an automatic tagging pipeline and apply it to 5.6M samples across datasets from different stages of the LLM pipeline. Each sample is annotated along multiple dimensions: cultural content, domain, task intent, geolocation, and language. The cultural taxonomy includes Culture as Knowledge, Dynamics, Preference, and Bias, with additional labels for General Culture and No Culture. Language is tagged with FastText LangID, while the other annotations are produced mainly with Command-A. For pretraining corpora, the full text is tagged. For post-training and conversational data, only user-side prompts or instructions are tagged, because these determine whether the model is exposed to a culturally grounded learning opportunity. The dataset pool includes CulturaX, Dolci Instruct-SFT, GeoFact-X, CultureBank, MultiNRC, Aya original annotations, PRISM, and ShareLM.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical finding is a sharp decline of explicit cultural signals in later training stages. Post-training datasets become more geographically concentrated and more dominated by task-specialized content such as reasoning, coding, and generic instruction following. Multilingual data increases geographic diversity but still leaves cultural representation imbalanced. The paper also reports that explicit cultural tags improve performance on downstream cultural benchmarks, suggesting that the tags can be used not only for auditing but also for data selection or training interventions. The main limitation is that the analysis relies on automatic tagging, so the results are best interpreted as large-scale distributional diagnostics rather than fine-grained human judgments of cultural adequacy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: 25–35 minutes. Read the dataset selection and tagging taxonomy first, because the conclusions depend heavily on how culture, geolocation, task intent, and language are operationalized. Then focus on the stage-wise distribution results that show how cultural signals change from pretraining to post-training. The downstream benchmark section is useful for checking whether the tags have training utility. For data researchers, the main value is the audit protocol: inspect whether instruction, preference, and reasoning datasets systematically remove culturally grounded contexts.

recommendation.zh: 读标注体系和各训练阶段的漏斗统计；动作是审数据配比，不是再加推理时补丁。
recommendation.en: Read the taxonomy and stage-wise funnel statistics; the action item is auditing data mixtures, not adding another inference-time patch.

paper.title: Hubs or Fringes: Pretraining Data Selection via Web Graph Centrality
paper.abstract: The performance of modern language models depends critically on pretraining data composition. Yet existing data selection methods rely on auxiliary classifiers for document scoring or mixture optimization, adding computational overhead and dependence on labeled data. We propose WebGraphMix, a lightweight data selection framework that computes structural centrality scores over the Common Crawl host-level web graph and uses them to vary the proportion of central versus peripheral documents in the

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是预训练数据选择里一个很具体但长期被忽略的问题：现有方法大多把文档当独立样本，用内容分类器、质量打分器或 mixture optimization 来决定采样比例，却几乎不利用网页之间的链接结构。作者提出的问题不是“哪些网页写得更像高质量文本”，而是“网页在整个 web graph 里的结构位置，是否对应不同类型的可迁移知识，从而影响模型学到的能力”。更进一步，他们想要一个不依赖标注、不训练额外打分模型、能在 web 规模上运行的数据选择方法。
summary.importance:
这篇对预训练研究是实打实有分量的。贡献不在于提出更复杂的筛选器，而在于把数据选择的观察单位从独立文档扩展到图结构中的 host 位置，并且给出可复现的、低成本的 web-scale 实证。它的重要性有三层。

第一，它提供了一个与内容质量信号近似正交的新轴。论文里 centrality 与 DCLM-fasttext 质量分类器结合后还能继续提升，说明图结构不是在重复已有质量分数，而是在补充另一类信息。

第二，它把“数据 mixture 决定能力分布”这件事讲得更细。中心 host 更偏向可复用抽象和桥接性知识，边缘 host 更偏向长尾和专门知识；不同采样会把模型推向不同能力侧重。这比简单说‘高质量数据更好’要具体得多。

第三，它的工程门槛低。13.9M 节点、4.396 亿边的 host graph，全部 centrality 计算不到 9 GPU 小时，而且算一次可复用到很多实验。对真实预训练 pipeline 来说，这比训练一堆 proxy model 更容易落地。

量级上，这不是只在某个小 benchmark 上做微调的增量，而是一个值得进入数据配方工具箱的候选方向。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 WebGraphMix。核心设计很朴素：先在 Common Crawl 的 host-level hyperlink graph 上给每个 host 算结构中心性分数，再把属于这些 host 的文档映射回预训练语料，最后按 central / peripheral 的比例构造训练 mixture。

图的定义是 host 级而不是 page 级。每个节点是一个 host，例如 wikipedia.org；有向边表示 host 间超链接。作者用的是 Common Crawl 的 host graph，规模 13.9M nodes、439.6M directed edges。之所以选 host-level，而不是 page-level，一是规模可控，二是 host 级位置更稳定，也更适合和大规模语料中的文档来源对齐。

中心性主要试了两类：Betweenness centrality 和 Katz centrality。Betweenness 强调一个节点是否位于大量最短路径上，适合刻画“桥接不同社区”的 host；Katz centrality 则考虑来自邻居及更远节点的影响衰减，偏向刻画全局连接中的重要性。作者也试了 PageRank，但没有看到提升，这一点和 DCLM 里 PageRank 信号效果一般的观察一致。这个负结果其实很有信息量：对预训练数据来说，‘被很多节点指向’未必等于‘提供更有用的学习信号’，而桥接性和结构位置可能更关键。

拿到中心性分数后，作者把语料按 host 分桶，构造几种 mixture：只采 central、只采 peripheral、以及 central/peripheral 的混合，尤其关注 50/50 这种简单配比。这里的关键不是做复杂的连续权重优化，而是先用可解释的结构分区，观察能力变化方向。

更有意思的是它和内容质量信号的结合方式。论文把 centrality 与 DCLM-fasttext 质量分类器做 multiplicative 和 divisive 组合打分。虽然全文细节公式需要结合方法节看，但直觉上是在问：如果一个文档既来自结构中心 host，又被内容分类器判为高质量，是否更值得采样；反过来，是否可以通过除法或重加权避免某一类信号完全主导。实验结果表明这种组合优于单独使用任一信号，说明 web graph topology 与文本内容质量确实捕捉到不同维度。

从方法取舍看，这篇工作刻意避免训练额外模型，也不做下游驱动的 mixture search。优点是轻、稳、可迁移；代价是 centrality 只是 host 级粗粒度信号，无法区分同一 host 内部页面质量差异，也可能把大型聚合站点的结构优势和真实文本价值混在一起。
summary.experiments:
实验设置比较扎实，且控制得干净。作者把 WebGraphMix 接进标准化的 DCLM pipeline，训练了 400M 和 1B 两个规模的模型，分别用 8B 和 28B tokens。tokenizer、shuffle、优化器、训练流程都保持一致，尽量把变量压到“数据选择”本身。评测用的是 DCLM CORE v2 的 23 个任务，覆盖较广。

关键结果有几组。

1. 单独看 central vs peripheral 的能力偏置：
在 1B 模型上，采样结构更中心的 host 文档，相比 uniform sampling，在 Symbolic & Algorithmic Reasoning 上提升 +1.4%。而采样更边缘的 host，则在 Science & Factual Knowledge 和 Commonsense & Reasoning 上更好。这个结果很重要，因为它说明图位置不是单调的‘越中心越好’，而是不同区域承载不同能力相关信号。

2. mixture 优于单边采样：
用 betweenness centrality 做 50% central + 50% peripheral 的混合，在 23 个任务平均分上达到 41.4%，而 uniform sampling 是 39.8%。这是 +1.6 个点的平均提升。对预训练数据配方来说，这个幅度不小，尤其考虑到方法几乎不增加训练时成本。

3. 与内容质量信号结合进一步提升：
把 centrality 和 DCLM-fasttext 质量分类器结合后，平均分提升到 43.8%。也就是说，相比 uniform 的 39.8%，总提升达到 +4.0 个点；相比只用 graph mixture 的 41.4%，还有 +2.4 个点增益。这是全文最关键的结果之一，因为它直接支持“图结构信号与内容质量信号大体互补”。

4. 计算成本：
完整 Common Crawl host graph 的 centrality 计算总共不到 9 GPU 小时。这个数字很关键，它说明方法不是理论上可行、工程上很重，而是真的可以作为预训练前处理步骤。

如果看消融，最值得注意的不是某个 centrality 指标谁赢得更多，而是三件事：PageRank 无明显收益；betweenness 的解释性更强且效果稳定；central/peripheral 的混合优于只押一边。它们共同说明，图结构信号的价值在于提供能力互补的数据子集，而不是简单排序出一批‘最好网页’。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇值得精读。建议先看 Introduction 前三段和方法总览，抓住作者的核心假设：中心 host 暴露可复用抽象，边缘 host 保留长尾知识。然后直接看方法节里 graph construction、betweenness/Katz 定义、以及如何把 host score 映射回文档采样。这里要特别注意作者为什么选 host-level graph，以及为什么不把问题做成训练一个 document scorer。

实验部分建议按下面顺序读：
1. 主结果表：uniform、central-only、peripheral-only、50/50 mixture、与 fasttext 结合的结果。
2. 各能力子类结果：尤其是 Symbolic & Algorithmic、Science & Factual、Commonsense 三类，最能体现能力偏置。
3. centrality 指标对比和 PageRank 负结果。
4. 计算成本与可扩展性说明。

精读时有几个值得深挖的点。第一，host centrality 到 document utility 的映射是否过粗，未来是否应做 page-level 或 host-within-page hybrid。第二，central/peripheral 的最优比例是否随模型规模、token budget、训练阶段变化，是否可以做 curriculum 或 annealing。第三，图结构信号是否能和去重、质量过滤、domain mixture 一起形成更系统的数据配方，而不是单独使用。第四，中心 host 提升符号推理这一现象，究竟来自更强的模板复用、更多教程型文本，还是更高的跨域连接性；这值得后续做更细的机制分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a concrete gap in pretraining data selection. Most existing pipelines treat documents as independent units and rely on content-based quality filters, domain classifiers, or mixture optimization. They largely ignore the fact that the web is a graph. The central question here is whether a document's structural position in the hyperlink graph correlates with the kind of knowledge it contributes during pretraining, and whether that signal can be used for data selection without labels, auxiliary models, or downstream-driven search.
summary_en.importance:
This is a meaningful pretraining paper. Its contribution is not a more elaborate scorer, but a new selection axis: web-graph position. That matters for three reasons.

First, it provides a signal that appears complementary to content quality. When graph centrality is combined with the DCLM-fasttext quality classifier, performance improves beyond either signal alone. That suggests topology is not just a noisy proxy for existing quality scores.

Second, it sharpens the discussion around data mixtures and capability allocation. Central hosts seem to favor reusable abstractions and bridge-like information, while peripheral hosts contribute long-tail and specialized knowledge. The result is not 'higher quality is better' in a generic sense, but 'different structural regions induce different capability trade-offs.'

Third, the method is lightweight enough to matter in practice. Computing centrality on a 13.9M-node, 439.6M-edge host graph takes under 9 GPU hours and can be reused across many training runs. That is a much lower barrier than training multiple proxy models.

Overall, this looks like a credible addition to the pretraining data toolbox rather than a narrow benchmark trick.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, WebGraphMix, is simple by design. It computes structural centrality scores on the Common Crawl host-level hyperlink graph, maps those host scores back to documents in the pretraining corpus, and constructs mixtures that emphasize central hosts, peripheral hosts, or combinations of the two.

The graph is defined at the host level rather than the page level. Each node is a host such as wikipedia.org, and each directed edge indicates that one host links to another. The graph contains 13.9 million nodes and 439.6 million edges. This choice is important: host-level graphs are much more tractable than page-level graphs, and host identity aligns naturally with large-scale corpus provenance.

The paper mainly studies betweenness centrality and Katz centrality. Betweenness captures whether a host lies on many shortest paths and therefore acts as a bridge across otherwise weakly connected regions. Katz centrality measures global influence with distance decay. The authors also tried PageRank but did not observe gains, which is itself informative. For pretraining, being heavily linked may not be the same as providing broadly useful learning signals; bridge structure may matter more than raw popularity.

Once centrality scores are computed, documents are partitioned by host score and sampled into different mixtures: central-only, peripheral-only, and mixed settings such as 50/50. The point is not to solve a continuous optimization problem, but to create interpretable structural slices and observe how they affect learned capabilities.

A particularly useful part of the paper is the combination with content-based quality signals. The authors combine centrality with the DCLM-fasttext quality classifier using multiplicative and divisive scoring. The exact formulas matter less than the design intent: reward documents that are strong under both signals, while preventing one signal from completely dominating the other. The gains from this combination indicate that graph topology and textual quality capture different aspects of pretraining value.

The trade-off is clear. The method is cheap, unsupervised, and portable, but host-level centrality is coarse. It cannot distinguish high-value and low-value pages within the same host, and it may conflate structural prominence with actual textual usefulness for large aggregator sites.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental setup is strong and well controlled. WebGraphMix is integrated into the standardized DCLM pipeline. Models are trained at 400M and 1B scales with 8B and 28B tokens respectively. Tokenization, shuffling, optimization, and training procedures are held fixed so that the main variable is data selection. Evaluation uses the 23-task DCLM CORE v2 benchmark.

Several results stand out.

1. Central and peripheral regions favor different capabilities.
At 1B scale, sampling from structurally central hosts improves Symbolic and Algorithmic Reasoning by +1.4% over uniform sampling. In contrast, sampling from peripheral hosts improves Science and Factual Knowledge as well as Commonsense and Reasoning. This is one of the paper's most important findings: graph position is not a monotonic quality ranking. Different parts of the web graph support different capability profiles.

2. Mixed sampling beats one-sided selection.
Using betweenness centrality, a 50% central plus 50% peripheral mixture reaches 41.4% average across the 23 tasks, compared with 39.8% for uniform sampling. A +1.6 point average gain is substantial for a data-selection intervention with almost no training-time overhead.

3. Graph structure and content quality are complementary.
Combining centrality with the DCLM-fasttext quality classifier raises the average to 43.8%. That is +4.0 points over uniform sampling and +2.4 points over the graph-only 50/50 mixture. This is the strongest evidence that topology provides information largely orthogonal to content-based quality scoring.

4. The preprocessing cost is low.
Computing centrality over the full host graph takes fewer than 9 GPU hours in total. This matters because it makes the method operationally plausible for real pretraining pipelines.

The most informative ablations are not about tiny differences between centrality metrics. They are: PageRank does not help, betweenness is stable and interpretable, and central-peripheral mixtures outperform either extreme alone. Together these results suggest that graph structure is useful because it exposes complementary data regions, not because it identifies a single best subset.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one is worth a careful read. Start with the introduction and the method overview to lock in the main hypothesis: central hosts expose reusable abstractions, while peripheral hosts preserve long-tail knowledge. Then read the graph construction details, the definitions of betweenness and Katz centrality, and the mapping from host scores to document sampling. Pay attention to why the paper chooses host-level structure and why it avoids training a document scorer.

For the experiments, read in this order: the main comparison table with uniform, central-only, peripheral-only, 50/50 mixtures, and the combined graph-plus-fasttext results; then the capability breakdowns, especially Symbolic and Algorithmic, Science and Factual, and Commonsense; then the centrality-metric comparison including the negative PageRank result; and finally the compute-cost discussion.

A few deeper questions are worth carrying through the paper. Is host-level centrality too coarse, and would page-level or hybrid scoring work better? Does the best central-peripheral ratio change with model size, token budget, or training stage, suggesting a curriculum or annealing schedule? Can graph structure be integrated with deduplication, quality filtering, and domain mixtures into a more systematic recipe? And why exactly do central hosts help symbolic reasoning: because of more tutorial-style text, more reusable templates, or stronger cross-domain connectivity? Those are good follow-up directions.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你做 web-scale mixture 的先验：先看它是否在固定 token budget 下稳定优于 learned scorer，再决定要不要把图结构信号接进内部数据管线。
recommendation.en: This can change your prior on web-scale mixture design: first check whether graph centrality beats learned scorers under fixed token budgets, then decide if structural signals belong in your data pipeline.

paper.title: Repetition Mismatch: Why Data Mixture Experiments Don't Scale and How to Fix Them
paper.abstract: Pre-training data mixtures are commonly tuned by running small-scale experiments and extrapolating to the target training budget. When high-quality data is scarce and must be repeated, this extrapolation frequently fails, but the source of the failure has not been isolated. summary.core_problem: 解决预训练数据配比实验在从小规模代理实验外推到目标训练预算时经常失效的问题，尤其是在高质量小数据集必须被重复采样的场景下。
summary.importance: 这是很实在的 pretrain 方法论文。贡献不是又画一条 scaling 曲线，而是隔离出一个长期被混在一起的混杂因素：repetition mismatch。它直接影响数据混合实验的可迁移性、compute 使用效率，以及高质量稀缺数据在大训练预算下的最优占比判断。
summary.technical_approach: 作者指出，小规模 mixture sweep 之所以不能可靠外推，一个主要原因是高质量小数据集在不同训练 horizon 下的重复率会变化，导致最优 mixture 随预算漂移。为控制这个变量，论文提出 repetition-controlled subsampling：在小规模代理实验中对子数据集做抽样，使其重复率与目标预算下保持一致。这样可以用单个低成本实验更准确地预测目标预算下的最优配比。
summary.experiments: 在一个 two-source 设置中，将有限高质量数据与 web crawl 混合，在 757M 参数模型上，只用目标 token 数的 1/16 做一次 repetition-controlled 实验，就能把 mixture 预测误差控制在距最优 0.05 以内；若不控制 repetition，误差达到 0.75。要达到相近精度，不做控制需要跑 3-4 个 horizon，计算成本高得多。这个 setup 虽然简化，但足够干净，能把 repetition 变量单独拎出来。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Marek Rei。若无论文首页机构信息，不宜进一步补充。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses why pretraining data-mixture experiments often fail to extrapolate from small proxy runs to the target training budget, especially when scarce high-quality data must be repeated.
summary_en.importance: This is a genuinely useful pretraining-method paper. The contribution is not another generic scaling plot; it isolates a confound that has often been mixed into data-mixture tuning: repetition mismatch. That directly affects mixture transferability, compute efficiency, and how one should reason about the optimal share of scarce high-quality data at larger budgets.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors argue that small-scale mixture sweeps fail mainly because the repetition rate of small high-quality datasets changes with training horizon, causing the optimal mixture to drift with budget. To control this variable, they propose repetition-controlled subsampling: in the proxy experiment, subsample data so that its repetition rate matches the one expected at the target budget. This lets a single low-cost run predict the target-budget optimum much more accurately.
summary_en.experiments: In a two-source setup mixing limited high-quality data with web crawl, a single repetition-controlled run using only 1/16 of the target tokens recovers a mixture within 0.05 of the optimum for a 757M-parameter model, whereas the error is 0.75 without repetition control. Achieving similar accuracy without the control requires three to four horizons, at much higher compute cost. The setup is simplified but clean enough to isolate repetition as the key variable.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Marek Rei. Further institutional details should not be added without confirmation from the paper metadata.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改你做 data mixture sweep 的实验设计：先匹配重复率再谈外推；建议立刻在内部 proxy pipeline 复现，不然很多配比结论都不干净。
recommendation.en: This should change how you run data-mixture sweeps: match repetition before extrapolating. It is worth reproducing in your internal proxy pipeline, or many mixture conclusions remain confounded.

paper.title: LLMSurgeon: Diagnosing Data Mixture of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: The pretraining data mixture of Large Language Models (LLMs) constitutes their "digital DNA", shaping model behaviors, capabilities, and failure modes. Yet this composition is rarely disclosed, making post-hoc auditing of data combination or provenance difficult. In this work, we formalize $\textbf{Data Mixture Surgery (DMS)}$: given only generated text from a target LLM, estimate the domain-level distribution of its pretraining corpus under a predefined taxonomy. We propose $\textbf{LLMSurgeon}

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究如何在无法访问训练数据和模型权重的情况下，仅凭目标 LLM 生成的文本，估计其预训练语料在给定领域 taxonomy 下的混合比例。它把问题定义为 Data Mixture Surgery，而不是传统的单样本 membership inference。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于，它提供了一个后验审计数据配比的框架。很多模型能力差异、偏置和失效模式都和数据混合有关，但公开模型通常不给出完整 recipe。LLMSurgeon 不能恢复精确训练集，也不能发现 taxonomy 之外的新数据源；它估计的是模型生成行为中的 latent effective prior。即便如此，这类方法对比较不同基座模型的数据倾向、验证公开数据声明、分析 domain over/under-representation 有直接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: LLMSurgeon 将数据配比估计建模为 label shift 下的逆问题。假设不同领域的条件语言分布相对稳定，即“当模型生成代码时，其文本统计特征仍像代码”，变化的是各领域的先验比例。流程分三步。第一，使用已知参考语料训练一个领域分类器，并估计 calibrated soft confusion matrix，用来刻画分类器在相近领域之间的系统性混淆。第二，用中性提示从目标 LLM 采样文本，再用冻结分类器得到观测到的领域分布。第三，不直接汇总分类器输出，而是利用 soft confusion matrix 对观测分布做反卷积式校正，求解最能解释生成样本的 latent mixture vector。这个设计的关键区别是：它承认分类器输出有偏，并显式校正这种偏差；朴素 aggregation 方法则把分类器预测当成真实标签，容易在相近领域上累积误差。
summary.experiments: 实验提出 LLMScan 作为评测基准，选择数据 recipe 较透明的开源 LLM，使预测的 domain mixture 可以和可验证的真实配比或公开配方比较。正文给出的结果是，LLMSurgeon 明显优于直接聚合分类器输出等 baseline。给定内容没有提供完整数值表、领域 taxonomy 细节、采样规模、误差指标和各模型逐项结果。需要注意的是，方法估计的是生成分布中的 π，而不是严格意义上的训练语料 α；训练动态、对齐、提示模板和采样温度都会让二者产生偏差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看问题定义部分，确认它估计的是 predefined taxonomy 下的 mixture，而不是开放式数据溯源。方法部分重点看 soft confusion matrix 的估计、校准方式、逆问题求解和约束。实验部分重点看 LLMScan 的模型选择、taxonomy 设计、采样提示是否足够中性，以及与 naive aggregation、MIA-style baseline 的误差对比。局限性也值得看：label shift 假设、分类器域外泛化、alignment 对生成分布的扭曲，都会决定这个方法在真实闭源模型上的可信度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to estimate the domain-level mixture of an LLM’s pretraining corpus using only generated text from the target model, without access to weights or training data. It frames this as Data Mixture Surgery, a distribution-recovery problem rather than instance-level membership inference.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is relevant to pretraining because data mixture is one of the main hidden variables behind model behavior. LLMSurgeon offers a post-hoc auditing tool for comparing domain tendencies across foundation models and checking whether public data claims are plausible. It does not recover exact documents, and it cannot discover domains outside a predefined taxonomy. Its estimate is closer to the model’s effective generation prior than to the literal training mixture, but that is still useful for model analysis and governance.
summary_en.technical_approach: LLMSurgeon casts mixture recovery as an inverse problem under a label-shift assumption. The assumption is that domain-conditional language patterns remain stable, while the domain prior changes. In practical terms, generated code should still look statistically like code, even if the model generates code more or less often than it appeared in training. The pipeline has three stages. First, train an external domain classifier on reference data and estimate a calibrated soft confusion matrix that captures systematic confusions between domains. Second, sample neutral outputs from the target LLM and classify them with the frozen classifier. Third, instead of treating classifier predictions as ground truth, solve a de-biasing problem using the confusion matrix to recover the latent mixture vector. The key difference from naive aggregation is that classifier bias is modeled explicitly rather than ignored.
summary_en.experiments: The paper introduces LLMScan, a benchmark built from open-source LLMs with relatively transparent data recipes, so mixture estimates can be compared against verifiable references. The reported finding is that LLMSurgeon outperforms aggregation-based baselines. The supplied text does not include the full numerical tables, the exact taxonomy, sampling size, error metrics, or per-model results. A key interpretation caveat is that the recovered vector is the generated effective prior π, not necessarily the exact pretraining mixture α; optimization, alignment, prompt choice, and decoding temperature can all move the two apart.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the formal problem definition to check the scope: predefined taxonomy, domain-level proportions, and generated-text-only access. Then read the sections on soft confusion-matrix estimation, calibration, and inverse-problem solving. In the experiments, focus on how LLMScan is constructed, whether the neutral prompts are actually neutral, and how the method compares with naive aggregation and membership-inference-style baselines. The limitations are important: the reliability depends on the label-shift assumption, classifier calibration, taxonomy quality, and the extent to which alignment distorts generation.

recommendation.zh: 把逆向推断 pretrain data mixture 建模为 label-shift 逆问题，思路巧妙，对做数据配比分析和竞品审计的研究员很有启发，重点看其软混淆矩阵的估计方法。
recommendation.en: Modeling the reverse engineering of pretrain data mixture as a label-shift inverse problem is clever; highly inspiring for researchers doing data mixture analysis and competitor auditing, focus on the soft confusion matrix estimation.

paper.title: SuperValid: Capability-Aligned OOD Validation for Generalizable Downstream Scaling
paper.abstract: Scaling laws guide large language model training by relating compute to cross-entropy loss, and recent work further extends them to predict downstream benchmark performance. However, prior approaches face generalization limitations from two aspects: focusing on benchmark-level performance introduces scenario-specific artifacts, while relying on IID validation loss fails to track capability improvements when training distributions vary. In this work, we argue that downstream scaling should be stu

summary.core_problem: 训练中常用 IID validation loss 做早停/选模型/拟合 scaling law，但它在“训练分布变化（数据配比、数据源、架构变化）”时经常失灵：loss 主要反映对训练分布的拟合，不稳定地对应下游能力提升。另一方面，直接预测单个 benchmark 的分数又容易被 benchmark 模板、格式适配、知识覆盖偏差等“场景噪声”污染，跨模型/跨数据配比泛化差。论文要解决的是：能否构造一种更接近“能力”（capability）层面的验证信号，使得在跨架构、跨数据混合、跨规模时都能稳定预测下游表现，并能在训练过程中低成本计算。
summary.importance:
这是偏 pretrain 训练决策与 scaling 的工作：它把“验证集怎么选”从 IID held-out 提升到 capability-aligned OOD validation 的设计问题，目标是让一个可在线计算的 loss 成为更稳的 proxy，用于模型选择、早停、以及下游表现的可泛化预测。
对工业训练的直接价值在于：当你频繁改数据配比/清洗策略/混合域、或做架构 ablation 时，传统 IID loss 曲线往往无法比较不同 run 的真实能力；如果 SuperValid 的相关性在你的设置里成立，它能把一部分 benchmark evaluation 从训练环里拿掉，减少评测成本与决策噪声。
summary.technical_approach:
核心思路是把“预测目标”从 benchmark 分数换成“域能力变量”，再为每个能力域合成一个 OOD 的验证集，使其 loss 更像能力测量而不是分布拟合。
1) 能力域定义：把 16 个 benchmark 归到 6 个 capability domain（knowledge、basic math、intermediate math、code generation、code completion、reasoning）。对模型 M 的域能力用该域内多个 benchmark 的归一化分数做聚合（文中用平均）来近似不可观测的 c_k(M)。这样减少单一 benchmark 的格式/模板噪声。
2) SuperValid 数据合成：用 LLM 从 benchmark 中“蒸馏核心概念/技能成分（knowledge components）”，再扩展成语义更丰富、格式更一般的文本，形成 capability-aware 的 general text。关键约束是避免把 benchmark 的表面形式直接搬进验证集，从而降低 benchmark-specific artifacts。
3) Capability scaling law：用这些合成 OOD 验证集上的 loss 作为观测量，去拟合/预测域能力与下游表现。论文强调它在跨架构、跨数据混合时比 IID loss 更稳。
方法取舍上，它选择“合成 OOD 文本 + 用 loss 做 proxy”，而不是：
- 直接用 benchmark 做 validation（会过拟合 benchmark 形式，且训练中频繁跑 benchmark 成本高）；
- 继续用 IID held-out（对数据混合变化敏感，loss 与能力脱钩）；
- 训练一个显式能力评估器/判别器（引入额外模型与对齐问题）。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 16 个 benchmark、6 个能力域，并在多种开源模型家族上测试跨架构/跨规模/跨训练数据分布的泛化相关性。核心结果是：SuperValid loss 与下游表现的相关性“强且稳定”，并在各种设置下保持鲁棒；文中报告整体平均 MSE 为 1.51e-3（用于预测/拟合误差的量化指标）。
论文还强调在 data mixture 改变时，IID validation loss 的预测会明显漂移，而 SuperValid loss 的相关性更稳，从而更适合做训练中决策信号。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含完整实验表格、各域的相关系数/误差分解、以及与 prior downstream scaling 方法（如用 benchmark loss/score 拟合）的逐项对比数字；若要给出每个 setting 的具体提升幅度，需要补充结果章节与附录。）
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议（优先级从高到低）：
- 先读 Methodology 里“capability 作为隐变量”的定义与域划分：它决定了这个框架是否会把你关心的能力拆得足够细，还是过度平均。
- 重点看数据合成流水线的细节：knowledge components 如何抽取、如何扩展成 general text、如何避免 benchmark 模板泄漏；这部分决定了它能否跨数据配比泛化，也决定了你能否在内部复刻。
- 看 Figure 1（文中提到的失败案例）与主要相关性/误差表：关注跨 architecture、跨 data mixture 的分组结果，而不是单一平均值。
- 最后看消融：没有 OOD、没有 component 蒸馏、直接从 benchmark 改写、不同域粒度/不同聚合方式（mean vs 其它）对稳定性的影响。
如果要落地：建议先选你最在意的 1–2 个域（如 code、math），用你自己的 benchmark 集合重建 capability 聚合，再对比 IID loss 与 SuperValid loss 在“数据配比 sweep”中的 rank correlation/early-stop 一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: IID validation loss is a weak training-time signal for downstream capability when the training distribution changes (data mixture sweeps, different cleaning, architecture variants). Meanwhile, predicting individual benchmark scores tends to overfit benchmark-specific artifacts (templates, formats, narrow coverage), hurting cross-model and cross-mixture generalization. The paper asks: can we build a capability-level, OOD validation signal whose loss tracks real capability improvements and generalizes across architectures, scales, and data mixtures—while being cheap enough to compute during training?
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to pretraining decision-making and downstream scaling: it treats validation-set design as a first-class lever. If the proposed signal holds in practice, it can improve model selection and early stopping under frequent data-mixture/architecture iteration, and reduce reliance on expensive benchmark evaluations inside the training loop. The key contribution is not a new optimizer or recipe, but a more generalizable proxy metric for capability growth.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Three pillars:
1) Capability as the target: define domain-level latent capabilities (six domains) and approximate each capability c_k(M) by aggregating normalized scores across multiple benchmarks in that domain, reducing single-benchmark noise.
2) SuperValid OOD synthesis: use an LLM-driven pipeline to distill capability-relevant “knowledge components” from benchmarks, then expand them into diverse, capability-aware general text. The design goal is to avoid copying benchmark surface forms, thereby removing benchmark-specific artifacts.
3) Capability scaling law: use the loss on these synthesized OOD validation sets as an observable proxy for capability, and fit/predict downstream performance from it. The claim is that this loss is more stable than IID held-out loss under distribution shifts.
The approach intentionally avoids (a) using benchmarks directly as validation (artifact-prone and costly), (b) relying on IID held-out loss (mixture-sensitive), or (c) training a separate evaluator model (extra complexity and alignment issues).
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated across 16 benchmarks grouped into 6 capability domains, on multiple open-source model families, testing generalization across architectures, scales, and training data distributions. The headline quantitative result reported is an average MSE of 1.51e-3 for downstream prediction across settings, with strong and stable correlation between SuperValid loss and downstream performance.
A key empirical claim is robustness under data-mixture changes: IID validation loss correlations degrade or drift, while SuperValid remains stable.
(The provided excerpt does not include the full result tables, per-domain breakdowns, or detailed baselines; exact per-setting deltas require the full results/appendix sections.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Deep-read focus:
- Start with the capability formulation and domain grouping: check whether the aggregation hides important sub-skills for your use case.
- Spend time on the synthesis pipeline details (component extraction, expansion, anti-template leakage). This is the real “method,” and it determines reproducibility.
- Inspect the cross-architecture and cross-mixture breakdowns (not just averages). The value of SuperValid is in stability under shifts.
- Review ablations: OOD vs IID, component distillation vs direct rewriting, domain granularity, and aggregation choices.
For adoption, pilot on 1–2 domains (e.g., code/math) and measure rank correlation for early-stop/model selection across your own mixture sweeps.

recommendation.zh: 应优先读方法和实验相关性表；它把 validation set 当作能力探针做 scaling，值得在内部数据混合实验里复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and correlation tables first; treating validation data as a capability probe is worth reproducing in internal data-mixture scaling runs.

paper.title: What Really Improves Mathematical Reasoning: Structured Reasoning Signals Beyond Pure Code
paper.abstract: Code has become a standard component of modern foundation language model (LM) training, yet its role beyond programming remains unclear. We revisit the claim that code improves reasoning through controlled pretraining experiments on a 10T-token corpus with fine-grained domain separation. Our findings are threefold. First, when code is restricted to standalone executable programs and Code-NL data are controlled for, code substantially improves programming ability but does not act as a general rea

summary.core_problem: 论文重新检验一个预训练数据配比中的常见判断：代码数据是否真的提升通用数学推理。作者的核心结论是，纯可执行代码主要提升编程能力，并不会稳定提升数学推理；过去归因于 code 的推理收益，很大一部分可能来自 code-text、math-text 这类跨域结构化推理轨迹，而不是来自 standalone executable programs。
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练数据研究有直接价值。它把“代码比例”这个粗粒度变量拆成了更精细的数据类型：纯代码、代码-自然语言混合、数学文本、结构化数学推理样本。这个拆分很关键，因为预训练收益不是简单相加的。不同数据域之间存在竞争：增加一个域的 token，可能提升对应能力，同时压制另一个能力。对实际训练配方的启发是，不能只讨论 code 占比 10%、20% 或 30%，而要明确 code 中有多少是可执行程序，有多少是解释、题解、注释、教程、推理链和数学结构。论文的贡献主要是数据定义和受控实验，量级上属于对训练配方有实用影响的研究，而不是新模型架构。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了一个 10T token 的高质量预训练语料，并对领域做细粒度划分。在模型侧，使用不同规模的 MoE 从头预训练。MoE 的 FFN 被多个专家替代，router 为每个 token 选择专家，这使作者可以同时观察能力变化和 expert routing 模式。实验设计有两组关键消融。第一组把 algorithmic code 或 pure code 从更宽泛的代码数据中分离出来。这里的 pure code 定义很严格，只保留可执行函数或程序片段，排除解释性文字、注释和指令描述。这样可以避免把 code-text 混合数据的推理信号误算到纯代码上。第二组消融数学语料，观察数学数据和代码数据之间的相互影响。之后作者引入一种更有针对性的“结构化数学推理样本”：这些样本具有清晰的多步推理结构，并且在总数学 token 预算不变的前提下提高其占比，用来测试结构化推理信号是否比简单增加数学量更有效。最后，作者用 expert routing 分布和 hook-based 分析检查这些数据变化是否改变 MoE 的专家分工。
summary.experiments: 关键结果比较清楚。第一，纯代码显著提升编程能力，但没有作为通用推理增强器发挥作用；在控制 Code-NL 后，加入纯代码反而与知识密集任务竞争，尤其影响复杂数学推理。论文报告 pure code 使数学 benchmark 整体下降 14.38%。第二，数学数据对代码能力的影响也不是单向负迁移。加入数学数据可以让 competitive programming 最高提升 37.11%，但会让 code reasoning 最多下降 17.30%。这说明“代码能力”内部也需要拆分：竞赛编程更依赖算法和数学结构，代码推理可能更依赖程序语义、API 和工程模式。第三，在总数学 token 预算固定时，提高结构化数学推理样本比例，可以显著提升高难数学推理，而代码 benchmark 基本保持稳定，只出现约 1% 的轻微下降。第四，MoE routing 分析显示，这类结构化样本提升复杂推理时没有明显破坏专家分配，说明它更像一种跨域可共享的训练信号，而不是单纯挤占其他能力的数据域。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。优先看三部分。第一，语料构建和标签定义，尤其是 pure code、Code-NL、math-text、结构化数学推理样本如何区分；这决定了实验结论是否可信。第二，主消融表，重点看 pure code、math ablation、固定数学预算下改变结构化样本比例这几组对照。不要只看平均分，要看数学、competitive programming、code reasoning、知识密集任务分别如何变化。第三，MoE expert routing 和 hook-based 分析，它能帮助判断性能变化是简单数据竞争，还是出现了较稳定的跨域表征。Figure 7 中关于不同数据域 loss 的结果也值得看，因为 lower loss 不等价于更好的下游能力，这一点对数据筛选很重要。值得继续深挖的问题是：结构化推理样本的有效性来自格式、难度、显式步骤，还是来自更高的信息密度；以及在 dense Transformer 上是否会得到同样的数据竞争模式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits a common assumption in pretraining data design: code improves general mathematical reasoning. Its main finding is more restrictive. Pure executable code improves programming ability, but does not reliably improve mathematical reasoning once Code-NL mixtures are controlled. A large part of the reasoning gain often attributed to code appears to come from structured cross-domain traces, such as code-text and math-text mixtures, rather than standalone programs.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to pretraining data mixture research. The useful contribution is not a new architecture, but a cleaner data decomposition. Treating “code” as one bucket hides very different signals: executable programs, comments, explanations, tutorials, code-text mixtures, and math-like reasoning traces. The paper shows that domain effects are not additive. Adding one data type can improve its nearest capability while competing with knowledge-heavy or reasoning-heavy tasks. For practical corpus design, the result argues against tuning only the global code percentage. The composition inside the code bucket matters as much as the percentage itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a high-quality 10T-token corpus with fine-grained domain separation and pretrain MoE models of varying sizes from scratch. The MoE setup replaces standard FFNs with multiple experts and uses a router to assign tokens to experts, which also enables analysis of expert specialization. The core experimental design has two controlled ablations. First, they isolate pure code, defined strictly as executable functions or program fragments, excluding explanations, comments, and instructional text. This separates programming data from cross-domain reasoning traces. Second, they ablate the mathematics portion of the corpus to measure interactions between math and code. They then introduce a more targeted class of structured, mathematically grounded reasoning samples. By increasing this subset while keeping the total math-token budget fixed, they test whether explicit multi-step structure is more useful than simply adding more math tokens. Expert-routing distributions and hook-based analyses are used to inspect whether the new data changes expert allocation in a stable or disruptive way.
summary_en.experiments: The main results are concrete. Pure code improves programming but does not act as a general reasoning booster. After controlling for Code-NL, adding pure code is associated with a 14.38% overall drop on mathematical benchmarks, especially on complex math reasoning. Math data has nontrivial effects on coding as well: it improves competitive programming by up to 37.11%, while reducing code reasoning by as much as 17.30%. This split suggests that competitive programming benefits from algorithmic and mathematical structure, whereas code reasoning depends more on program semantics and engineering-like patterns. When the total math-token budget is held fixed, increasing structured reasoning samples improves difficult math benchmarks while leaving code benchmarks nearly unchanged, with only about a 1% drop. The routing analysis indicates that these structured samples improve complex reasoning without visibly destabilizing expert allocation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read closely. Start with the corpus taxonomy and filtering rules, especially the distinction between pure code, Code-NL, math-text, and structured mathematical reasoning samples. Then read the main ablation tables rather than only aggregate averages; the important signal is the asymmetric movement across math, competitive programming, code reasoning, and knowledge-intensive tasks. The MoE routing and hook-based analysis is worth reading to understand whether the gains come from stable cross-domain sharing or from domain competition. Figure 7 is also useful because it illustrates a practical point for pretraining: lower loss on a cleaner domain does not necessarily mean better reasoning transfer. A good follow-up question is whether the observed data competition persists in dense models and whether the benefit of structured reasoning comes from format, difficulty, explicit steps, or higher information density.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看实验设计：它会改变“加代码就涨推理”的默认数据配比假设，尤其要复现 Code-NL 控制组。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental design first: it challenges the default “more code improves reasoning” prior, especially the Code-NL-controlled ablations.

summary.core_problem: 文章讨论大模型预训练里的数据配比搜索：通用文本、数学、代码、多语言等语料该如何混合，才能在不反复重训整模的前提下，较便宜地找到更好的配方。
summary.key_insights: 核心信息有两点。第一，DeMix 试图把“配比搜索”与“完整训练”解耦：先训练单域模型，再通过模型合并去近似不同数据混合比例下的效果，用秒级合并替代一次次昂贵重训。文中给出的关键信号是，合并得到的性能排序与真实混合训练有较高一致性（ρ=0.81），并声称同等精度下可把搜索成本降到约 1/6。第二，作者把这个思路从预训练延伸到 mid-training 和 SFT，说明它不只是一个静态数据配方工具，而是在更广义的训练阶段配比选择上都有潜在用途。附带开源的 DeMix Corpora 也有一定参考价值，尤其是三阶段提升数学和代码占比的配方设计。
summary.limits: 这是一篇社交平台短笔记，信息密度有限，很多关键前提没有展开：模型合并近似真实混合训练的边界条件是什么，在哪些架构、规模、域间差异下会失效，ρ=0.81 对最终选配方是否足够稳定，都还需要回到论文和代码核实。另一个需要谨慎的点是，排序一致不等于绝对性能可精确预测，因此更适合作为候选筛选器，而不是完全替代真实训练。

summary_en.core_problem: This post is about data-mixture search for LLM pretraining: how to choose the proportions of general text, math, code, and multilingual data without repeatedly training full models from scratch.
summary_en.key_insights: The main idea behind DeMix is to decouple mixture search from full pretraining. Instead of retraining a model for every candidate recipe, it trains domain-specific models and uses model merging to approximate the outcome of different corpus mixtures. The post highlights two concrete claims: the ranking of merged candidates correlates well with real mixed-training results (rho = 0.81), and the search cost can drop by roughly 6x at similar accuracy. It also suggests the same recipe-search logic may transfer beyond pretraining into mid-training and even SFT, which makes it more interesting than a one-off corpus engineering trick. The released DeMix Corpora is also useful as a practical reference, especially the staged schedule that increases math and code over time.
summary_en.limits: This is still a short social-media summary, so the important caveats are missing. It does not explain when model merging is a good proxy for true mixed-domain training, how sensitive the method is to architecture and scale, or whether the correlation is stable enough for final recipe selection. A good ranking signal is helpful, but it is not the same as accurately predicting absolute downstream quality. Treat it as a promising search heuristic until the paper and code are checked in detail.

paper.title: Scaling Laws for Mixture Pretraining Under Data Constraints

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个很具体、但在真实预训练里经常被回避的问题：当目标数据源本身无法扩展时，预训练时应该给它多大混合权重，允许它被重复多少次，才能在目标域收益和过拟合之间取得最好平衡。这里的“目标数据”不是单一类型，而是三类常见受限来源：低资源语言、专业领域语料、以及高质量筛选子集。已有 data-constrained scaling law 主要研究单一数据源反复训练，结论通常是 4 次重复左右接近上限；已有 data mixing 工作则默认每个数据源都近似无限。这个工作处理的是两者之间的空白地带：一个源受限、另一个源充足，而且训练预算固定。论文要回答的不是“重复会不会坏”，而是“在混合训练里，重复的代价和收益如何随模型规模、目标数据规模、训练 token 预算共同变化，以及能否形成可外推的定量规律”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义很直接。第一，它把“有限高价值数据如何配比”从经验问题推进成了可拟合、可预测的问题。很多实际训练场景都符合这个设定，比如低资源语言继续预训练、代码/数学/科学语料注入、以及高质量数据占比控制。第二，它修正了一个常见但过于粗糙的工程经验：单源训练里 4 次重复常被当作上限，但在 mixture pretraining 中，只要通用数据持续提供新 token，目标数据的最优重复次数可以显著更高，论文里多处达到 15–20 次，而且并不必然伤害目标域表现。第三，它给出了一个可从小规模实验拟合、再外推到更大模型和更大预算的 scaling law，这对数据预算规划很有用：不必先做大规模网格搜索，就能估算目标数据该采多少、混多少、重复多少。贡献量级上，它不是提出新架构，而是把一个高频工程决策问题做成了系统经验规律和预测工具，这类工作对大规模预训练配方的影响往往比单点技巧更稳。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，论文把问题形式化为两源混合训练。目标域有固定唯一 token 数 D_target，总训练预算是 D_total，目标域在训练中的占比为 h。于是目标域平均重复次数 r 由 h、D_total、D_target 共同决定；通用域被视为足够大，不发生重复。核心建模对象是目标域 loss 如何依赖模型规模 N、目标数据规模 D_target、以及目标域训练 token 数 h·D_total，或者等价地依赖重复次数 r。

经验层面，作者做了大规模 sweep：超过 2000 次训练，模型规模从 101M 到 805M，覆盖多种目标数据大小和多种数据类型。数据设置分三类。多语言：以 FineWeb2 中德语为主，人工截断到 50M、100M、500M、1B token，并设无限数据对照；通用域是英语 FineWeb。还在法语和斯瓦希里语上做验证。多领域：目标域包括 OpenWebMath、Wikipedia、peS2o 科学论文等，通用域来自 DCLM、FineWeb、Nemotron-CC 等。质量过滤：对 DCLM 用 fastText 质量分类器打分，取 top 1/5/10/20% 作为“高质量但受限”的目标域，再与其余更充足数据混合。这样设计的好处是，它不是只在“英语+某专业语料”上得出结论，而是测试规律是否跨语言、跨领域、跨质量筛选机制稳定。

论文的关键观察有几个。其一，重复带来的收益是平滑递减的，而不是到某个阈值突然失效；过拟合也不是简单由重复次数单独决定，而是由“重复次数 × 模型规模 × 训练预算”共同塑造。其二，在 mixture setting 下，通用域持续提供新 token，会延缓单源重复训练中的退化，因此目标域可以承受远高于单源训练经验上限的重复。其三，大模型一方面更容易在目标域验证集上出现过拟合拐点，另一方面也更能从有限目标数据中榨出收益；也就是“学得更快，也更容易过头”。

在此基础上，作者拟合了一个目标域 loss 的 scaling law。虽然全文给出的具体函数形式带有若干可学习系数，但思想很清楚：把目标域 loss 分解为若干随模型规模、目标唯一数据量、目标域训练暴露量变化的幂律项，并显式建模重复导致的收益递减。这个形式既能覆盖“更多唯一数据更好”，也能覆盖“同一批数据重复仍有价值，但边际收益下降”。作者用小模型、小预算子集拟合参数，再外推到更大模型和更大预算，检验是否能预测最优 h 或最优 r。论文还把框架扩展到两个都受限的目标域，讨论多受限源之间如何分配预算。
summary.experiments:
实验是这篇文章最有分量的部分。规模上，全文报告了 2000+ 次训练运行，模型从 101M 到 805M。多语言主实验里，德语目标数据规模覆盖 50M、100M、500M、1B token 以及 unconstrained 对照；法语和斯瓦希里语用于验证规律是否迁移。多领域实验里，OpenWebMath 目标数据规模为 10M、100M、1B；Wikipedia 与 peS2o 也做了从千万到数十亿 token 的受限设置。质量过滤实验则把 DCLM 的 top 1%、5%、10%、20% 高质量子集当作受限目标域。

最关键的结果有三类。第一，最优重复次数远高于单源训练常见的 4 次经验值。论文在多个设置下都观察到，若目标是提升目标域表现，最优重复可达到 15–20 次。这个结论在低资源语言、专业领域和高质量子集三类数据上都成立，但具体最优点会随 D_target 和 D_total 改变。第二，随着训练预算增加，最优目标域占比 h 会下降，但最优重复次数 r 往往上升。原因是总训练 token 更多时，即便 h 变小，固定大小的目标数据仍会被见到更多轮。这一点很重要：固定“混合比例”不是稳健策略，预算变了，最优比例也会变。第三，larger model 在同样目标数据规模下通常能从更高重复中继续获益，但验证 loss 的过拟合拐点也更早出现，因此最优点更尖锐，配比更需要精调。

scaling law 的预测能力是另一项关键结果。作者展示了用较小规模实验拟合得到的参数，可以较准确地预测更大规模下目标域 loss 曲线以及最优重复次数/混合权重，而不需要在大规模上重新做完整 sweep。文中还比较了不同数据类型下拟合残差，说明规律并非只在某一个语料族上成立。对于两个受限目标域的扩展实验，结果表明该框架仍能给出合理的预算分配趋势：更小、更稀缺、但更相关的目标域通常需要更高的单位数据暴露，但也更快进入收益递减区间。

如果看消融和图表，Figure 1/2 直接展示了“重复次数—目标域性能—过拟合”之间的关系，是全文最先要看的结果图。后续关于不同模型规模、不同 D_target、不同数据类型的曲线，支持了“规律稳定但最优点可移动”这一判断。扩展到双受限域的章节则更像方法边界测试，说明这个 law 不只适用于 one-target-one-generic 的最简情形。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先读 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2，把论文真正回答的问题钉住：不是泛泛讨论 data mixing，而是在固定训练预算下，研究受限目标数据的最优暴露量。然后重点看 Methodology 里变量定义，尤其是 D_target、D_total、h、r 之间的关系。很多读者会把“混合比例”和“重复次数”混为一谈，这篇文章的价值恰恰在于把两者放进同一个坐标系里。

精读时最值得盯的有四处。第一，主实验图里最优点如何随模型规模和预算移动。这里能直接看到为什么固定 5% 或 10% 的 target ratio 不是通用策略。第二，scaling law 的函数形式和拟合流程。重点不是记公式，而是看它如何把唯一数据量和重复暴露拆开建模，以及小规模拟合为何能外推。第三，多语言、多领域、质量过滤三类实验的共性与差异。共性说明规律稳，差异说明参数不是通用常数。第四，双受限目标域扩展。这个部分对真实配方设计更接近，因为很多训练并不是“一个稀缺域 + 一个无限域”，而是多个都稀缺。

如果时间有限，优先看：Introduction、实验设置表、Figure 1/2、scaling law 拟合与外推结果、双目标域扩展。预计 45–60 分钟可以抓住主要结论；若要把它变成可执行配方，需要再仔细看附录里的拟合细节、不同数据族的参数稳定性，以及作者如何定义目标域评测集。最值得深挖的问题有两个：一是这个 law 是否能迁移到更大模型区间，尤其是数十 B 以上；二是当 generic data 也不是“无限新鲜”而是存在自身重复时，规律会如何变化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical pretraining regime that is common in real systems but poorly characterized in prior scaling-law work: one data source is scarce but valuable, while the other is abundant and generic. The question is how much of the fixed training budget should be allocated to the scarce target source, which directly determines how many times those target tokens are repeated. Too little target exposure under-trains the target domain; too much causes diminishing returns and eventual overfitting. Prior work on data-constrained training mostly considered repeating a single monolithic dataset, often leading to the rule of thumb that around four repetitions is near the useful limit. Prior work on data mixture optimization usually assumes every source is effectively unlimited. This paper fills the gap between those two settings and asks how model size, target-data size, and compute budget jointly determine the optimal repetition level in mixture pretraining.
summary_en.importance: This is important because it turns a recurring recipe-design problem into something measurable and, to some extent, predictable. Many pretraining scenarios fit this setup: low-resource language adaptation, domain injection for math/science/code, and mixing a small high-quality subset with a large generic corpus. The main empirical correction is that the familiar single-source repetition ceiling does not transfer to mixture training. When fresh generic tokens continue to arrive, the scarce target source can often be repeated much more aggressively, with optimal target-task repetition reaching roughly 15–20x in several settings. That changes how one should think about curriculum design, mixture weights, and data budgeting. The second contribution is a fitted scaling law that can be estimated at small scale and extrapolated to larger models and budgets, reducing the need for expensive large-scale sweeps. The paper does not introduce a new architecture; its value is in making a high-frequency pretraining decision more quantitative.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is a two-source mixture. The target source has a fixed number of unique tokens D_target, the total training budget is D_total, and h is the fraction of training tokens drawn from the target source. This induces a repetition factor r for the target source, while the generic source is assumed large enough to avoid repetition. The modeling goal is to predict target-domain loss as a function of model size, target-data size, and target exposure under a fixed compute budget.

The empirical study is broad: more than 2,000 training runs, model sizes from 101M to 805M parameters, and several target-data regimes. The paper covers three families of constrained data. For multilingual experiments, German from FineWeb2 is artificially capped at 50M, 100M, 500M, and 1B tokens, with English FineWeb as the abundant generic source; French and Swahili are used to test whether the pattern is language-specific. For domain mixtures, the target source includes OpenWebMath, Wikipedia, and peS2o, mixed with larger generic corpora such as DCLM, FineWeb, and Nemotron-CC. For quality-filtered mixtures, the authors score DCLM documents with a FastText quality classifier and treat the top 1/5/10/20% subsets as scarce high-quality targets.

The main empirical pattern is that repetition has smooth diminishing returns rather than a hard threshold, and the useful repetition range depends jointly on model size, target-data size, and total budget. Larger models overfit the target validation set sooner, but they also extract more value from limited target data before that point. The presence of fresh generic data changes the regime relative to single-source repetition: it keeps the model learning from new tokens even while the target source is being revisited many times.

On top of these observations, the paper fits a scaling law for target-domain loss. The exact parameterization is learned from data, but the conceptual structure is clear: it separates the effect of unique target data from the effect of repeated target exposure, and models both with smooth power-law-like terms. The law is then used to predict the optimal mixture weight or repetition count. The framework is also extended to the case of two scarce target domains, where the problem becomes one of allocating limited exposure across multiple constrained sources.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental section is the core of the paper. It reports 2,000+ runs with models ranging from 101M to 805M parameters. In the multilingual setting, German target data spans 50M, 100M, 500M, and 1B tokens plus an unconstrained reference; French and Swahili are used as additional checks. In the domain setting, OpenWebMath is capped at 10M, 100M, and 1B tokens, and Wikipedia and peS2o are also studied under constrained budgets. In the quality-filtering setting, top-ranked DCLM subsets are treated as scarce high-quality targets.

Three results matter most. First, the optimal repetition count in mixture pretraining is often far above the familiar single-source heuristic. For target-domain performance, the paper repeatedly finds useful optima around 15–20 repetitions in several settings. Second, as the total compute budget grows, the optimal target fraction h tends to decrease, while the optimal repetition count r can still increase, because the same fixed target pool is revisited more times over a longer run. This is a subtle but operationally important point: a fixed mixture ratio is not compute-invariant. Third, larger models can benefit from higher repetition on scarce target data, but their optimum is sharper because overfitting arrives sooner on the target validation set.

The scaling-law validation is another major result. Parameters fitted on smaller-scale runs are shown to extrapolate reasonably well to larger scales, predicting target-domain loss curves and the optimal repetition level without re-running a full large-scale sweep. The paper also reports that the qualitative pattern holds across multilingual, domain-specific, and quality-filtered mixtures, which suggests the phenomenon is not tied to one corpus family. The two-scarce-domain extension further shows that the framework can provide sensible allocation trends when more than one valuable source is data-limited.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the first two figures. They establish the actual question: not generic data mixing, but optimal exposure of a scarce target source under a fixed compute budget. Then read the setup carefully, especially the relationship among D_target, D_total, h, and r. A common failure mode is to think only in terms of mixture ratio; the paper is stronger when read through the lens of induced repetition.

For a close read, focus on four parts. First, the main result plots showing how the optimum moves with model size and budget. This is where the paper makes clear why a fixed target ratio is not a robust recipe. Second, the scaling-law form and fitting procedure. The key is not memorizing the equation, but understanding how the law separates unique-data effects from repeated-exposure effects. Third, compare the multilingual, domain, and quality-filtered sections to see what is stable and what is dataset-specific. Fourth, read the extension to two constrained target domains; that section is closer to real recipe design than the simplest one-target-plus-generic setup.

If time is limited, read the introduction, the experimental setup, Figures 1 and 2, the scaling-law extrapolation results, and the multi-target extension. That is enough to capture the main contribution in under an hour. If the goal is to operationalize the result, spend more time on the appendix details for fitting, parameter stability across data families, and the exact target-domain evaluation protocol. Two follow-up questions are especially worth thinking about: whether the law still holds at much larger model scales, and how it changes when the generic source is not truly fresh and also begins to repeat.
